Farmata hai ke yeh Arabi ka Quran Allah Rahman ka utara hua hai. Jaise aur ayat mein farmaya, ise tere Rab ke hukm se Rooh-ul-Amin ne haq ke sath nazil farmaya hai. Aur ayat mein hai, Rooh-ul-Amin ne ise tere dil par is liye nazil farmaya hai ke tu logon ko aagah karne wala ban jaye, is ki ayatein mufassal hain, un ke ma'ani zahir hain, ahkaam mazboot hain. Alfaaz wazeh aur aasaan hain jaise aur ayat mein hai (Kitabun uhkimat ayatu-hu thumma fussilat min ladun Hakeemin Khabeer) (Surah Hud: 1), yeh kitab hai jis ki ayatein muhkam-o-mufassal hain, yeh kalam hai Hakeem-o-Khabeer Allah Jalla Shanahu ka, lafz ke aitbar se mo'jiz aur ma'ani ke aitbar se mo'jiz. Batil is ke qareeb phatak bhi nahin sakta. Hakeem-o-Hameed Rab ki taraf se utara gaya hai. Is bayan-o-wazahat ko zi-ilm samajh rahe hain. Yeh ek taraf mominon ko basharat deta hai, dusri janib mujrimon ko dhamkata hai, kuffar ko darata hai. Bawajood in khubiyon ke phir bhi aksar Quraishi munh phere hue aur kanon mein rui diye behre hue hain, phir mazeed dhitai dekho ke khud kehte hain ke teri pukar sunne mein hum behre hain, tere aur hamare darmiyan aar hain, teri baatein na hamari samajh mein ayin na aql mein samayin, ja tu apne tariqe par amal karta chala ja, hum apna tariqa-e-kaar hargiz na chhodenge, namumkin hai ke hum teri maan lein. Musnad Abd bin Hameed mein Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) se manqool hai ke ek din Quraishiyon ne jama ho kar aapas mein mushawarat ki ke jadoo, kahanat aur sher-o-shayari mein jo sab se zyada ho use sath le kar is shakhs ke paas chalein (yani An-Hazrat ﷺ jis ne hamari jam'iyat mein tafreeq daal di hai aur hamare kaam mein phoot daal di hai aur hamare deen mein aib nikalna shuru kar diya hai) woh is se munazra kare aur ise hara de aur lajawab kar de. Sab ne kaha ke aisa shakhs to hum mein bajuz Utba bin Rabia ke aur koi nahin. Chunancha yeh sab mil kar Utba ke paas aaye aur apni muttafiqa khwahish zahir ki. Us ne qoum ki baat rakh li aur tayyar ho kar Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya. Aa kar kehne laga ke ae Muhammad ﷺ yeh to bata tu achha hai ya Abdullah? (yani aap ke walid sahab). Aap ne koi jawab na diya. Us ne dusra sawal kiya ke tu achha hai ya tera dada Abdul Muttalib? Huzoor ﷺ is par bhi khamosh rahe. Woh kehne laga sun agar tu apne tain dadon ko achha samajhta hai tab to tumhein maloom hai woh inhi maboodon ko poojte rahe jin ko hum poojte hain aur jin ki tu aib-geeri karta rehta hai aur agar tu apne aap ko un se behtar samajhta hai to hum se baat kar hum bhi teri baatein sunein. Qasam Allah ki dunya mein koi insan apni qoum ke liye tujh se zyada zarar-rasan paida nahin hua. Tu ne hamari shiraza-bandi ko tod diya, tu ne hamare ittefaq ko nifaq se badal diya, tu ne hamare deen ko aib-daar bataya aur is mein burai nikali, tu ne sare Arab mein hamein badnaam aur ruswa kar diya, aaj har jagah yahi tazkira hai ke Quraishiyon mein ek jadugar hai, Quraishiyon mein kahan hai.

Ab toh yahi ek baat baqi reh gayi hai ke hum mein aapas mein sar phatool ho, ek dusre ke saamne hathiyar laga kar aajayein aur yunhi lada bhida kar toh hum sab ko fana kar dena chahta hai, sun! Agar tujhe maal ki khwahish hai toh le hum sab mil kar tujhe is qadar maal jama kar dete hain ke Arab mein tere barabar koi aur tunagar na nikle. Aur tujhe auraton ki khwahish hai ke tu hum mein se jis ki beti tujhe pasand ho toh bata hum ek chhod das das shadiyan teri kara dete hain. Yeh sab kuch keh kar ab usne zara saans liya toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya bas keh chuke? Usne kaha haan! Aap ne farmaya ab meri suno! Chunancha aap ne Bismillah padh kar isi Surah ki tilawat shuru ki aur taqreeban dedh ruku (مِّثْلَ صٰعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَّثَمُوْدَ 13ۭ) (Surah Fussilat: 13) tak padha itna sun kar Utba bol pada bas kijiye aap ke paas is ke siwa kuch nahin? Aap ne farmaya nahin. Ab yeh yahan se uth kar chal diya Quraish ka majma is ka muntazir tha. Unhon ne dekhte hi poocha kaho kya baat rahi? Utba ne kaha suno tum sab mil kar jo kuch use keh sakte the main ne akele hi woh sab kuch keh dala. Unhon ne kaha phir us ne kuch jawab bhi diya? Kaha haan jawab toh diya lekin billah main toh ek harf bhi is ka samajh nahin saka albatta itna samjha hoon ke unhon ne hum sab ko azaab-e-aasmani se daraya hai jo azaab qaum-e-Aad aur qaum-e-Samood par aaya tha. Unhon ne kaha tujhe Allah ki maar ek shakhs Arabi zaban mein jo teri apni zaban hai tujh se kalam kar raha hai aur tu kehta hai main samjha hi nahin ke us ne kya kaha? Utba ne jawab diya ke main sach kehta hoon bajuz zikr-e-azaab ke main kuch nahin samjha. Baghawi (R.H) bhi is riwayat ko laye hain is mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat ki toh Utba ne aap ke munh mubarak par haath rakh diya aur aap ko qasmein dene laga aur rishtedari yaad dilane laga. Aur yahan se ulte paon wapas ja kar ghar mein baitha. Aur Quraishiyon ki baithak mein aana jana tark kar diya. Is par Abu Jahl ne kaha ke Quraishiyo! Mera khayal toh yeh hai ke Utba bhi Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf jhuk gaya hai aur wahan ke khane peene mein lalcha gaya hai woh haajat mand tha achha tum mere saath ho lo main is ke paas chalta hoon. Use theek kar loonga. Wahan ja kar Abu Jahl ne kaha Utba tum ne jo hamare paas aana jana chhoda is ki wajah ek aur sirf ek hi maloom hoti hai ke tujhe is ka dastarkhwan pasand aa gaya aur tu bhi isi ki taraf jhuk gaya hai. Haajat mandi buri cheez hai mera khayal hai ke hum aapas mein chanda kar ke teri halat theek kar dein. Taake is museebat aur zillat se tu chhoot jaye. Is se darne ki aur naye mazhab ki tujhe zaroorat na rahe. Is par Utba bahut bigda aur kehne laga mujhe Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki kya gharz hai? Allah ki qasam main ab is se kabhi baat tak na karunga. Aur tum meri nisbat aise zaleel khayalat zahir karte ho halankeh tumhein maloom hai ke Quraish mein mujh se badh kar koi maaldar nahin.

Baat sirf yeh hai ke main tum sab ko kehne se un ke paas gaya, sara qissa keh sunaya, bahut baatein kaheen. Mere jawab mein phir jo kalam us ne parha, wallah na to woh sher tha, na kahanat ka kalam tha, na jadoo waghera tha. Woh jab is surat ko parhte hue ayat (FA-IN A'RAZU FAQUL ANZARTUKUM SA'IQATAN MISLA SA'IQATI 'ADIN WA SAMUD - 41. Fussilat: 13) tak pohanche to main ne un ke munh par hath rakh diya aur unhein rishte naate yaad dilane laga ke lillah ruk jao, mujhe to khauf laga hua tha ke kahin isi waqt hum par woh azab aa na jaye aur yeh to tum sab ko maloom hai ke Muhammad (ﷺ) jhoote nahin. Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein yeh waqia dusre tareeqe par hai, is mein hai ke Quraishiyon ki majlis ek martaba jama thi aur An-Hazrat (ﷺ) Khana-e-Ka'aba ke ek goshe mein baithe hue thay. Utba Quraish se kehne laga ke agar tum sab ka mashwara ho to Muhammad (ﷺ) ke paas jaon, unhein kuch samjhaon aur kuch lalach doon, agar woh kisi baat ko qabool kar lein to hum unhein de dein aur unhein un ke kaam se rok dein. Yeh waqia us waqt ka hai ke Hazrat Hamza (R.A) musalman ho chuke thay aur musalmanon ki tadaad maqool ho gayi thi aur roz-afzoon hoti jati thi. Sab Quraishi is par razamand hue. Yeh Huzoor (ﷺ) ke paas aaya aur kehne laga, baradar-zade! Tum aali nasab ho, tum hum mein se ho, hamari aankhon ke taare aur hamare kaleje ke tukre ho. Afsos ke tum apni qoum ke paas ek ajeeb-o-ghareeb cheez laye ho, tum ne un mein phoot dalwa di. Tum ne un ke aqal-mandon ko bewaqoof qarar diya. Tum ne un ke maboodon ki aib-joi ki. Tum ne un ke deen ko bura kehna shuru kiya. Tum ne un ke bare boorhon ko kafir banaya. Ab sun lo, aaj main aap ke paas ek aakhri aur intehai faisle ke liye aaya hoon, main bahut si suratein pesh karta hoon, un mein se jo aap ko pasand ho qabool kijiye. Lillah is fitne ko khatam kar dijiye. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya jo tumhein kehna ho kaho, main sun raha hoon. Us ne kaha suno, agar tumhara irada is chaal se maal ke jama karne ka hai to hum sab mil kar tumhare liye itna maal jama kar dete hain ke tum se barh kar maldar saare Quraish mein koi na ho. Aur agar aap ka irada is se apni sardari ka hai to hum sab mil kar aap ko apna sardar tasleem kar lete hain. Aur agar aap badshah banna chahte hain to hum mulk aap ko sonp kar khud ri'aya banne ke liye bhi tayyar hain, aur agar aap ko koi jin waghera ka asar hai to hum apna maal kharch kar ke behtar se behtar tabeeb aur jhaar-phoonk karne wale muhayya kar ke aap ka ilaj karate hain. Aisa ho jata hai ke ba'az martaba tabi' jin apne aamil par ghalib aa jata hai to isi tarah us se chhutkara hasil kiya jata hai. Ab Utba khamosh hua to aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya apni sab baat keh chuke? Kaha haan. Farmaya ab meri suno. Woh mutawajja ho gaya, aap (ﷺ) ne Bismillah parh kar is surat ki tilawat shuru ki. Utba ba-adab sunta raha yahan tak ke aap (ﷺ) ne sajde ki ayat parhi aur sajda kiya. Farmaya Abu-al-Waleed! Main keh chuka, ab tujhe ikhtiyar hai.

Utbah yahan se utha aur apne sathiyon ki taraf chala, uske chehre ko dekhte hi har ek kehne laga ke Utbah ka haal badal gaya. Us se poocha kaho kya baat rahi? Usne kaha main ne toh aisa kalam suna hai jo wallah is se pehle kabhi nahin suna. Wallah! Na toh woh jadu hai, na sher koi hai, na kahinon ka kalam hai. Suno Quraishiyo! Meri maan lo aur meri is jachi tuli baat ko qabool kar lo. Use uske khayalat par chhod do, na uski mukhalifat karo na ittefaq. Uski mukhalifat mein sara Arab kafi hai aur jo yeh kehta hai is mein tamam Arab uska mukhalif hai, woh apni tamam taqat is ke muqable mein sarf kar raha hai. Ya toh woh is par ghalib aa jayenge, agar woh is par ghalib aa gaye toh tum saste chhoote, ya yeh un par ghalib aaya toh uska mulk tumhara hi mulk kehlayega aur uski izzat tumhari izzat hogi aur sab se zyada uske nazdeek maqbool tum hi hoge. Yeh sun kar Quraishiyon ne kaha Abu Al-Waleed qasam Allah ki Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tujh par jadu kar diya. Usne jawab diya meri apni jo raye thi azadi se keh chuka, ab tumhein apne fe'l ka ikhtiyar hai.

Batil is ke qareeb phatak bhi nahin sakta. Hakeem-o-Hameed Rab ki taraf se utara gaya hai. Is bayan-o-wazahat ko zi-ilm samajh rahe hain. Yeh ek taraf mominon ko basharat deta hai, dusri janib mujrimon ko dhamkata hai, kuffar ko darata hai. Bawajood in khubiyon ke phir bhi aksar Quraishi munh phere hue aur kanon mein rui diye behre hue hain, phir mazeed dhitai dekho ke khud kehte hain ke teri pukar sunne mein hum behre hain, tere aur hamare darmiyan aar hain, teri baatein na hamari samajh mein ayin na aql mein samayin, ja tu apne tariqe par amal karta chala ja, hum apna tariqa-e-kaar hargiz na chhodenge, namumkin hai ke hum teri maan lein. Sab ne kaha ke aisa shakhs to hum mein bajuz Utba bin Rabia ke aur koi nahin. Chunancha yeh sab mil kar Utba ke paas aaye aur apni muttafiqa khwahish zahir ki. Us ne qoum ki baat rakh li aur tayyar ho kar Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya. Aa kar kehne laga ke ae Muhammad ﷺ yeh to bata tu achha hai ya Abdullah? (yani aap ke walid sahab). Aap ne koi jawab na diya. Us ne dusra sawal kiya ke tu achha hai ya tera dada Abdul Muttalib? Huzoor ﷺ is par bhi khamosh rahe. Woh kehne laga sun agar tu apne tain dadon ko achha samajhta hai tab to tumhein maloom hai woh inhi maboodon ko poojte rahe jin ko hum poojte hain aur jin ki tu aib-geeri karta rehta hai aur agar tu apne aap ko un se behtar samajhta hai to hum se baat kar hum bhi teri baatein sunein. Qasam Allah ki dunya mein koi insan apni qoum ke liye tujh se zyada zarar-rasan paida nahin hua. Tu ne hamari shiraza-bandi ko tod diya, tu ne hamare ittefaq ko nifaq se badal diya, tu ne hamare deen ko aib-daar bataya aur is mein burai nikali, tu ne sare Arab mein hamein badnaam aur ruswa kar diya, aaj har jagah yahi tazkira hai ke Quraishiyon mein ek jadugar hai, Quraishiyon mein kahan hai.

Ab toh yahi ek baat baqi reh gayi hai ke hum mein aapas mein sar phatool ho, ek dusre ke saamne hathiyar laga kar aajayein aur yunhi lada bhida kar toh hum sab ko fana kar dena chahta hai, sun! Agar tujhe maal ki khwahish hai toh le hum sab mil kar tujhe is qadar maal jama kar dete hain ke Arab mein tere barabar koi aur tunagar na nikle. Aur tujhe auraton ki khwahish hai ke tu hum mein se jis ki beti tujhe pasand ho toh bata hum ek chhod das das shadiyan teri kara dete hain. Chunancha aap ne Bismillah padh kar isi Surah ki tilawat shuru ki aur taqreeban dedh ruku (مِّثْلَ صٰعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَّثَمُوْدَ 13ۭ) (Surah Fussilat: 13) tak padha itna sun kar Utba bol pada bas kijiye aap ke paas is ke siwa kuch nahin? Aap ne farmaya nahin. Ab yeh yahan se uth kar chal diya Quraish ka majma is ka muntazir tha. Unhon ne dekhte hi poocha kaho kya baat rahi? Utba ne kaha suno tum sab mil kar jo kuch use keh sakte the main ne akele hi woh sab kuch keh dala. Unhon ne kaha phir us ne kuch jawab bhi diya? Kaha haan jawab toh diya lekin billah main toh ek harf bhi is ka samajh nahin saka albatta itna samjha hoon ke unhon ne hum sab ko azaab-e-aasmani se daraya hai jo azaab qaum-e-Aad aur qaum-e-Samood par aaya tha. Unhon ne kaha tujhe Allah ki maar ek shakhs Arabi zaban mein jo teri apni zaban hai tujh se kalam kar raha hai aur tu kehta hai main samjha hi nahin ke us ne kya kaha? Utba ne jawab diya ke main sach kehta hoon bajuz zikr-e-azaab ke main kuch nahin samjha. Baghawi (R.H) bhi is riwayat ko laye hain is mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat ki toh Utba ne aap ke munh mubarak par haath rakh diya aur aap ko qasmein dene laga aur rishtedari yaad dilane laga. Aur yahan se ulte paon wapas ja kar ghar mein baitha. Aur Quraishiyon ki baithak mein aana jana tark kar diya. Is par Abu Jahl ne kaha ke Quraishiyo! Mera khayal toh yeh hai ke Utba bhi Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf jhuk gaya hai aur wahan ke khane peene mein lalcha gaya hai woh haajat mand tha achha tum mere saath ho lo main is ke paas chalta hoon. Use theek kar loonga. Wahan ja kar Abu Jahl ne kaha Utba tum ne jo hamare paas aana jana chhoda is ki wajah ek aur sirf ek hi maloom hoti hai ke tujhe is ka dastarkhwan pasand aa gaya aur tu bhi isi ki taraf jhuk gaya hai. Uski mukhalifat mein sara Arab kafi hai aur jo yeh kehta hai is mein tamam Arab uska mukhalif hai, woh apni tamam taqat is ke muqable mein sarf kar raha hai. Ya toh woh is par ghalib aa jayenge, agar woh is par ghalib aa gaye toh tum saste chhoote, ya yeh un par ghalib aaya toh uska mulk tumhara hi mulk kehlayega aur uski izzat tumhari izzat hogi aur sab se zyada uske nazdeek maqbool tum hi hoge. Yeh sun kar Quraishiyon ne kaha Abu Al-Waleed qasam Allah ki Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tujh par jadu kar diya. Usne jawab diya meri apni jo raye thi azadi se keh chuka, ab tumhein apne fe'l ka ikhtiyar hai.

Farmata hai ke yeh Arabi ka Quran Allah Rahman ka utara hua hai. Jaise aur ayat mein farmaya, ise tere Rab ke hukm se Rooh-ul-Amin ne haq ke sath nazil farmaya hai. Aur ayat mein hai, Rooh-ul-Amin ne ise tere dil par is liye nazil farmaya hai ke tu logon ko aagah karne wala ban jaye, is ki ayatein mufassal hain, un ke ma'ani zahir hain, ahkaam mazboot hain. Alfaaz wazeh aur aasaan hain jaise aur ayat mein hai (Kitabun uhkimat ayatu-hu thumma fussilat min ladun Hakeemin Khabeer) (Surah Hud: 1), yeh kitab hai jis ki ayatein muhkam-o-mufassal hain, yeh kalam hai Hakeem-o-Khabeer Allah Jalla Shanahu ka, lafz ke aitbar se mo'jiz aur ma'ani ke aitbar se mo'jiz. Batil is ke qareeb phatak bhi nahin sakta. Hakeem-o-Hameed Rab ki taraf se utara gaya hai. Is bayan-o-wazahat ko zi-ilm samajh rahe hain. Yeh ek taraf mominon ko basharat deta hai, dusri janib mujrimon ko dhamkata hai, kuffar ko darata hai. Bawajood in khubiyon ke phir bhi aksar Quraishi munh phere hue aur kanon mein rui diye behre hue hain, phir mazeed dhitai dekho ke khud kehte hain ke teri pukar sunne mein hum behre hain, tere aur hamare darmiyan aar hain, teri baatein na hamari samajh mein ayin na aql mein samayin, ja tu apne tariqe par amal karta chala ja, hum apna tariqa-e-kaar hargiz na chhodenge, namumkin hai ke hum teri maan lein. Musnad Abd bin Hameed mein Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) se manqool hai ke ek din Quraishiyon ne jama ho kar aapas mein mushawarat ki ke jadoo, kahanat aur sher-o-shayari mein jo sab se zyada ho use sath le kar is shakhs ke paas chalein (yani An-Hazrat ﷺ jis ne hamari jam'iyat mein tafreeq daal di hai aur hamare kaam mein phoot daal di hai aur hamare deen mein aib nikalna shuru kar diya hai) woh is se munazra kare aur ise hara de aur lajawab kar de. Sab ne kaha ke aisa shakhs to hum mein bajuz Utba bin Rabia ke aur koi nahin. Chunancha yeh sab mil kar Utba ke paas aaye aur apni muttafiqa khwahish zahir ki. Us ne qoum ki baat rakh li aur tayyar ho kar Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya. Aa kar kehne laga ke ae Muhammad ﷺ yeh to bata tu achha hai ya Abdullah? (yani aap ke walid sahab). Aap ne koi jawab na diya. Us ne dusra sawal kiya ke tu achha hai ya tera dada Abdul Muttalib? Huzoor ﷺ is par bhi khamosh rahe. Woh kehne laga sun agar tu apne tain dadon ko achha samajhta hai tab to tumhein maloom hai woh inhi maboodon ko poojte rahe jin ko hum poojte hain aur jin ki tu aib-geeri karta rehta hai aur agar tu apne aap ko un se behtar samajhta hai to hum se baat kar hum bhi teri baatein sunein. Qasam Allah ki dunya mein koi insan apni qoum ke liye tujh se zyada zarar-rasan paida nahin hua. Tu ne hamari shiraza-bandi ko tod diya, tu ne hamare ittefaq ko nifaq se badal diya, tu ne hamare deen ko aib-daar bataya aur is mein burai nikali, tu ne sare Arab mein hamein badnaam aur ruswa kar diya, aaj har jagah yahi tazkira hai ke Quraishiyon mein ek jadugar hai, Quraishiyon mein kahan hai.

Ab toh yahi ek baat baqi reh gayi hai ke hum mein aapas mein sar phatool ho, ek dusre ke saamne hathiyar laga kar aajayein aur yunhi lada bhida kar toh hum sab ko fana kar dena chahta hai, sun! Agar tujhe maal ki khwahish hai toh le hum sab mil kar tujhe is qadar maal jama kar dete hain ke Arab mein tere barabar koi aur tunagar na nikle. Aur tujhe auraton ki khwahish hai ke tu hum mein se jis ki beti tujhe pasand ho toh bata hum ek chhod das das shadiyan teri kara dete hain. Yeh sab kuch keh kar ab usne zara saans liya toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya bas keh chuke? Usne kaha haan! Aap ne farmaya ab meri suno! Chunancha aap ne Bismillah padh kar isi Surah ki tilawat shuru ki aur taqreeban dedh ruku (مِّثْلَ صٰعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَّثَمُوْدَ 13ۭ) (Surah Fussilat: 13) tak padha itna sun kar Utba bol pada bas kijiye aap ke paas is ke siwa kuch nahin? Aap ne farmaya nahin. Ab yeh yahan se uth kar chal diya Quraish ka majma is ka muntazir tha. Unhon ne dekhte hi poocha kaho kya baat rahi? Utba ne kaha suno tum sab mil kar jo kuch use keh sakte the main ne akele hi woh sab kuch keh dala. Unhon ne kaha phir us ne kuch jawab bhi diya? Kaha haan jawab toh diya lekin billah main toh ek harf bhi is ka samajh nahin saka albatta itna samjha hoon ke unhon ne hum sab ko azaab-e-aasmani se daraya hai jo azaab qaum-e-Aad aur qaum-e-Samood par aaya tha. Unhon ne kaha tujhe Allah ki maar ek shakhs Arabi zaban mein jo teri apni zaban hai tujh se kalam kar raha hai aur tu kehta hai main samjha hi nahin ke us ne kya kaha? Utba ne jawab diya ke main sach kehta hoon bajuz zikr-e-azaab ke main kuch nahin samjha. Baghawi (R.H) bhi is riwayat ko laye hain is mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat ki toh Utba ne aap ke munh mubarak par haath rakh diya aur aap ko qasmein dene laga aur rishtedari yaad dilane laga. Aur yahan se ulte paon wapas ja kar ghar mein baitha. Aur Quraishiyon ki baithak mein aana jana tark kar diya. Is par Abu Jahl ne kaha ke Quraishiyo! Mera khayal toh yeh hai ke Utba bhi Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf jhuk gaya hai aur wahan ke khane peene mein lalcha gaya hai woh haajat mand tha achha tum mere saath ho lo main is ke paas chalta hoon. Use theek kar loonga. Wahan ja kar Abu Jahl ne kaha Utba tum ne jo hamare paas aana jana chhoda is ki wajah ek aur sirf ek hi maloom hoti hai ke tujhe is ka dastarkhwan pasand aa gaya aur tu bhi isi ki taraf jhuk gaya hai. Haajat mandi buri cheez hai mera khayal hai ke hum aapas mein chanda kar ke teri halat theek kar dein. Taake is museebat aur zillat se tu chhoot jaye. Is se darne ki aur naye mazhab ki tujhe zaroorat na rahe. Is par Utba bahut bigda aur kehne laga mujhe Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki kya gharz hai? Allah ki qasam main ab is se kabhi baat tak na karunga. Aur tum meri nisbat aise zaleel khayalat zahir karte ho halankeh tumhein maloom hai ke Quraish mein mujh se badh kar koi maaldar nahin.

Baat sirf yeh hai ke main tum sab ko kehne se un ke paas gaya, sara qissa keh sunaya, bahut baatein kaheen. Mere jawab mein phir jo kalam us ne parha, wallah na to woh sher tha, na kahanat ka kalam tha, na jadoo waghera tha. Woh jab is surat ko parhte hue ayat (FA-IN A'RAZU FAQUL ANZARTUKUM SA'IQATAN MISLA SA'IQATI 'ADIN WA SAMUD - 41. Fussilat: 13) tak pohanche to main ne un ke munh par hath rakh diya aur unhein rishte naate yaad dilane laga ke lillah ruk jao, mujhe to khauf laga hua tha ke kahin isi waqt hum par woh azab aa na jaye aur yeh to tum sab ko maloom hai ke Muhammad (ﷺ) jhoote nahin. Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein yeh waqia dusre tareeqe par hai, is mein hai ke Quraishiyon ki majlis ek martaba jama thi aur An-Hazrat (ﷺ) Khana-e-Ka'aba ke ek goshe mein baithe hue thay. Utba Quraish se kehne laga ke agar tum sab ka mashwara ho to Muhammad (ﷺ) ke paas jaon, unhein kuch samjhaon aur kuch lalach doon, agar woh kisi baat ko qabool kar lein to hum unhein de dein aur unhein un ke kaam se rok dein. Yeh waqia us waqt ka hai ke Hazrat Hamza (R.A) musalman ho chuke thay aur musalmanon ki tadaad maqool ho gayi thi aur roz-afzoon hoti jati thi. Sab Quraishi is par razamand hue. Yeh Huzoor (ﷺ) ke paas aaya aur kehne laga, baradar-zade! Tum aali nasab ho, tum hum mein se ho, hamari aankhon ke taare aur hamare kaleje ke tukre ho. Afsos ke tum apni qoum ke paas ek ajeeb-o-ghareeb cheez laye ho, tum ne un mein phoot dalwa di. Tum ne un ke aqal-mandon ko bewaqoof qarar diya. Tum ne un ke maboodon ki aib-joi ki. Tum ne un ke deen ko bura kehna shuru kiya. Tum ne un ke bare boorhon ko kafir banaya. Ab sun lo, aaj main aap ke paas ek aakhri aur intehai faisle ke liye aaya hoon, main bahut si suratein pesh karta hoon, un mein se jo aap ko pasand ho qabool kijiye. Lillah is fitne ko khatam kar dijiye. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya jo tumhein kehna ho kaho, main sun raha hoon. Us ne kaha suno, agar tumhara irada is chaal se maal ke jama karne ka hai to hum sab mil kar tumhare liye itna maal jama kar dete hain ke tum se barh kar maldar saare Quraish mein koi na ho. Aur agar aap ka irada is se apni sardari ka hai to hum sab mil kar aap ko apna sardar tasleem kar lete hain. Aur agar aap badshah banna chahte hain to hum mulk aap ko sonp kar khud ri'aya banne ke liye bhi tayyar hain, aur agar aap ko koi jin waghera ka asar hai to hum apna maal kharch kar ke behtar se behtar tabeeb aur jhaar-phoonk karne wale muhayya kar ke aap ka ilaj karate hain. Aisa ho jata hai ke ba'az martaba tabi' jin apne aamil par ghalib aa jata hai to isi tarah us se chhutkara hasil kiya jata hai. Ab Utba khamosh hua to aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya apni sab baat keh chuke? Kaha haan. Farmaya ab meri suno. Woh mutawajja ho gaya, aap (ﷺ) ne Bismillah parh kar is surat ki tilawat shuru ki. Utba ba-adab sunta raha yahan tak ke aap (ﷺ) ne sajde ki ayat parhi aur sajda kiya. Farmaya Abu-al-Waleed! Main keh chuka, ab tujhe ikhtiyar hai.

Utbah yahan se utha aur apne sathiyon ki taraf chala, uske chehre ko dekhte hi har ek kehne laga ke Utbah ka haal badal gaya. Us se poocha kaho kya baat rahi? Usne kaha main ne toh aisa kalam suna hai jo wallah is se pehle kabhi nahin suna. Wallah! Na toh woh jadu hai, na sher koi hai, na kahinon ka kalam hai. Suno Quraishiyo! Ya toh woh is par ghalib aa jayenge, agar woh is par ghalib aa gaye toh tum saste chhoote, ya yeh un par ghalib aaya toh uska mulk tumhara hi mulk kehlayega aur uski izzat tumhari izzat hogi aur sab se zyada uske nazdeek maqbool tum hi hoge. Yeh sun kar Quraishiyon ne kaha Abu Al-Waleed qasam Allah ki Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tujh par jadu kar diya. Usne jawab diya meri apni jo raye thi azadi se keh chuka, ab tumhein apne fe'l ka ikhtiyar hai.

Husool-e-Najat aur Ittiba-e-Rasool (ﷺ). Allah ka hukum ho raha hai ke in jhutlane wale mushrikon ke samne elaan kar dijiye ke main tum hi jaisa ek insaan hoon. Mujhe bazariya-e-Wahi Ilahi ke hukum diya gaya hai ke tum sab ka Mabood ek akela Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Tum jo mutafarriq aur kayi ek mabood banaye baithe ho yeh tareeqa sarasar gumrahi wala hai. Tum sari ibadatein usi ek Allah ke liye baja lao. Aur theek isi tarah jis tarah tumhein us ke Rasool se maloom ho. Aur apne agle gunahon se tauba karo. Un ki maafi talab karo. Yaqeen mano ke Allah ke sath shirk karne wale halak hone wale hain, jo Zakat nahin dete. Yani baqol Ibn Abbas (R.A) La Ilaha Illallah ki shahadat nahin dete. Ikrama (R.H) bhi yahi farmate hain. Quran-e-Kareem mein ek jagah hai (Qad aflaha man zakkaha) (91. Ash-Shams: 9) yani us ne falah payi jis ne apne nafs ko pak kar liya. Aur woh halak hua jis ne use daba diya. Aur aayat mein farmaya (Qad aflaha man tazakka) (87. Al-A'la: 14) yani us ne najat hasil kar li jis ne pakeezgi ki aur apne Rabb ka naam zikr kiya phir namaz ada ki. Aur jagah irshad hai (Hal laka ila an tazakka) (79. An-Nazi'at: 18) kya tujhe pak hone ka khayal hai? In aayaton mein Zakat yani paki se matlab nafs ko behooda akhlaq se door karna hai aur sab se badi aur pehli qisam is ki shirk se pak hona hai, isi tarah aayat-e-mandarja bala mein bhi Zakat na dene se Tauheed ka na manna murad hai. Maal ki Zakat ko Zakat is liye kaha jata hai ke yeh hurmat se pak kar deti hai. Aur ziyadati aur barkat aur kasrat-e-maal ka ba'is banti hai. Aur Allah ki rah mein use kharch ki taufeeq hoti hai. Lekin Imam Sa'di, Mawiya bin Qurra, Qatada aur aksar mufassireen ne is ke ma'ani yeh kiye hain ke maal-e-Zakat ada nahin karte. Aur bazahir yahi maloom hota hai Imam Ibn Jarir (R.H) bhi isi ko mukhtar kehte hain. Lekin yeh qaul ta'ammul talab hai. Is liye ke Zakat farz hoti hai Madine mein jakar hijrat ke dusre saal. Aur yeh aayat utri hai Makka Sharif mein. Zyada se zyada is tafseer ko maan kar hum yeh keh sakte hain ke sadqe aur Zakat ki asal ka hukum to nabuwwat ki ibtida mein hi tha, jaise Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ka farman hai (Wa aatu haqqahu yauma hasadihi) (6. Al-An'am: 141) jis din khet kaato us ka haq de diya karo. Haan woh Zakat jis ka nisaab aur jis ki miqdar min janib-e-Allah muqarrar hai woh Madine mein muqarrar hui. Yeh qaul aisa hai jis se dono baton mein tatbeeq bhi ho jati hai. Khud namaz ko dekhiye ke tulu-e-aftab aur ghuroob-e-aftab se pehle ibtida-e-nabuwwat mein hi farz ho chuki thi. Lekin Me'raj wali raat hijrat se dedh saal pehle panchon namazein baqaida shuroot-o-arkaan ke sath muqarrar ho gayin. Aur rafta rafta is ke tamam muta'allaqat poore kar diye gaye Wallahu A'lam, is ke baad Allah Ta'ala Jalla Jalaluhu farmata hai, ke Allah ke manne walon aur Nabi (ﷺ) ke itaat guzaaron ke liye woh ajr-o-sawab hai jo daimi hai aur kabhi khatam nahin hone wala hai.

Jaise aur jagah hai (Maakitheena feeha abada) (Surah Al-Kahf: 3) woh is mein hamesha hamesha rehne wale hain aur farmata hai (Ata'an ghaira majooth) (Surah Hud: 108) unhein jo inaam diya jaye ga woh na tootne wala aur musalsal hai. Suddi kehte hain goya woh un ka haq hai jo unhein diya gaya na ke bator-e-ehsan hai. Lekin ba'az aimma ne is ki tardeed ki hai. Kyunke Ahl-e-Jannat par bhi Allah ka ehsan yaqeenan hai. Khud Quran mein hai: (Balillahu yamunnu alaikum an hadakum lil-imani in kuntum sadiqeen) (Surah Al-Hujurat: 17) ya'ni balkeh Allah ka tum par ehsan hai ke woh tumhein iman ki hidayat karta hai. Jannatiyon ka qaul hai: (Famannallahu alaina wa waqana azabas-samoom) (Surah At-Tur: 27) pas Allah ne hum par ehsan kiya aur aag ke azab se bacha liya. Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain magar yeh ke mujhe apni rahmat mein le le aur apne fazl-o-ehsan mein.

Yaqeen mano ke Allah ke sath shirk karne wale halak hone wale hain, jo Zakat nahin dete. Yani baqol Ibn Abbas (R.A) La Ilaha Illallah ki shahadat nahin dete. Ikrama (R.H) bhi yahi farmate hain. Aur aayat mein farmaya (Qad aflaha man tazakka) (87. Al-A'la: 14) yani us ne najat hasil kar li jis ne pakeezgi ki aur apne Rabb ka naam zikr kiya phir namaz ada ki. Aur jagah irshad hai (Hal laka ila an tazakka) (79. An-Nazi'at: 18) kya tujhe pak hone ka khayal hai? In aayaton mein Zakat yani paki se matlab nafs ko behooda akhlaq se door karna hai aur sab se badi aur pehli qisam is ki shirk se pak hona hai, isi tarah aayat-e-mandarja bala mein bhi Zakat na dene se Tauheed ka na manna murad hai. Maal ki Zakat ko Zakat is liye kaha jata hai ke yeh hurmat se pak kar deti hai. Aur ziyadati aur barkat aur kasrat-e-maal ka ba'is banti hai. Aur Allah ki rah mein use kharch ki taufeeq hoti hai. Lekin Imam Sa'di, Mawiya bin Qurra, Qatada aur aksar mufassireen ne is ke ma'ani yeh kiye hain ke maal-e-Zakat ada nahin karte. Aur bazahir yahi maloom hota hai Imam Ibn Jarir (R.H) bhi isi ko mukhtar kehte hain. Lekin yeh qaul ta'ammul talab hai. Is liye ke Zakat farz hoti hai Madine mein jakar hijrat ke dusre saal. Aur yeh aayat utri hai Makka Sharif mein. Zyada se zyada is tafseer ko maan kar hum yeh keh sakte hain ke sadqe aur Zakat ki asal ka hukum to nabuwwat ki ibtida mein hi tha, jaise Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ka farman hai (Wa aatu haqqahu yauma hasadihi) (6. Al-An'am: 141) jis din khet kaato us ka haq de diya karo. Haan woh Zakat jis ka nisaab aur jis ki miqdar min janib-e-Allah muqarrar hai woh Madine mein muqarrar hui. Yeh qaul aisa hai jis se dono baton mein tatbeeq bhi ho jati hai. Khud namaz ko dekhiye ke tulu-e-aftab aur ghuroob-e-aftab se pehle ibtida-e-nabuwwat mein hi farz ho chuki thi. Lekin Me'raj wali raat hijrat se dedh saal pehle panchon namazein baqaida shuroot-o-arkaan ke sath muqarrar ho gayin. Aur rafta rafta is ke tamam muta'allaqat poore kar diye gaye Wallahu A'lam, is ke baad Allah Ta'ala Jalla Jalaluhu farmata hai, ke Allah ke manne walon aur Nabi (ﷺ) ke itaat guzaaron ke liye woh ajr-o-sawab hai jo daimi hai aur kabhi khatam nahin hone wala hai.

Jaise aur jagah hai (Maakitheena feeha abada) (Surah Al-Kahf: 3) woh is mein hamesha hamesha rehne wale hain aur farmata hai (Ata'an ghaira majooth) (Surah Hud: 108) unhein jo inaam diya jaye ga woh na tootne wala aur musalsal hai. Suddi kehte hain goya woh un ka haq hai jo unhein diya gaya na ke bator-e-ehsan hai. Lekin ba'az aimma ne is ki tardeed ki hai. Kyunke Ahl-e-Jannat par bhi Allah ka ehsan yaqeenan hai. Khud Quran mein hai: (Balillahu yamunnu alaikum an hadakum lil-imani in kuntum sadiqeen) (Surah Al-Hujurat: 17) ya'ni balkeh Allah ka tum par ehsan hai ke woh tumhein iman ki hidayat karta hai. Jannatiyon ka qaul hai: (Famannallahu alaina wa waqana azabas-samoom) (Surah At-Tur: 27) pas Allah ne hum par ehsan kiya aur aag ke azab se bacha liya. Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain magar yeh ke mujhe apni rahmat mein le le aur apne fazl-o-ehsan mein.

Takhleeq-e-Kainat ka marhala-war zikr. Har cheez ka Khaliq, har cheez ka Malik, har cheez par Hakim, har cheez par Qadir sirf Allah Ta'ala hai. Pas ibadatein bhi sirf usi ki karni chahiyein. Us ne zameen jaisi wasee makhlooq ko apni kamal qudrat se sirf do din mein paida kar diya hai. Tumhein na us ke sath kufr karna chahiye na shirk. Jis tarah sab ka paida karne wala wahi ek hai, theek usi tarah sab ka palne wala bhi wahi ek hai. Yeh tafseel yaad rahe ke aur aayaton mein zameen-o-aasman ka chhe din mein paida karna bayan hua hai, aur yahan us ki paidaish ka waqt alag bayan ho raha hai. Pas maloom hua ke pehle zameen banayi gayi. Imarat ka qaida yahi hai ke pehle bunyadein aur neeche ka hissa tayyar kiya jata hai phir oopar ka hissa aur chhat banayi jati hai. Chunancha Kalam-e-Allah Sharif ki ek aur aayat mein hai: Allah woh hai jis ne tumhare liye zameen mein jo kuch hai paida karke phir aasmanon ki taraf tawajjah farmayi aur unhein theek saat aasman bana diye. Haan Surah Naziyat mein (Wal-arda ba'da zalika dahaha) (79. An-Naziyat: 30) hai, pehle aasman ki paidaish ka zikr hai phir farmaya hai ke zameen ko us ke baad bichaya. Is se murad zameen mein se pani chara nikalna aur pahadon ka gaarna hai jaise ke us ke baad ka bayan hai. Yani paida pehle zameen ki gayi phir aasman phir zameen ko theek thaak kiya. Lehaza dono aayaton mein koi farq nahin. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se poocha ke ba'az aayaton mein mujhe kuch ikhtilaf sa nazar aata hai. Chunancha ek aayat mein hai (Fala ansaba bainahum yauma'izin wala yatasa'aloon) (23. Al-Mu'minoon: 101) yani Qayamat ke din aapas ke nasab na honge aur na ek dusre se sawal karega. Dusri aayat mein hai (Wa aqbala ba'duhum ala ba'din yatasa'aloon) (37. As-Saffat: 27) yani ba'az aapas mein ek dusre ki taraf mutawajjah ho kar pooch gachh karenge. Ek aayat mein hai (Wala yaktumoonallaha hadisa) (4. An-Nisa: 42) yani Allah se koi baat chhupayenge nahin. Dusri aayat mein hai ke mushrikeen kahenge (Wallahi Rabbina ma kunna mushrikeen) (6. Al-An'am: 23) Allah ki qasam hum ne shirk nahin kiya. Ek aayat mein hai zameen ko aasman ke baad bichaya (Wal-arda ba'da zalika dahaha) (79. An-Naziyat: 30), dusri aayat (Qul a-unabbi'ukum bikhairim min zalikum) (3. Aali-Imran: 15) mein pehle zameen ki paidaish phir aasman ki paidaish ka zikr hai. Ek to in aayaton ka sahih matlab bataye jis se ikhtilaf uth jaye. Dusre yeh jo farmaya hai (Allahu Azizan Hakima) (4. An-Nisa: 158) to kya yeh matlab hai ke Allah aisa tha? Is ke jawab mein aap (R.A) ne farmaya ke jin do aayaton mein se ek mein aapas ka sawal jawab hai aur ek mein un ka inkar hai, yeh do waqt hain. Soor mein do nifkhe phonke jayenge, ek ke baad aapas ki pooch gachh kuch na hogi, ek ke baad aapas mein ek dusre se sawalat honge.

Jin do dusri aayaton mein ek mein baat ke na chhupane ka aur ek mein chhupane ka zikr hai yeh bhi do mauqay hain jab mushrikeen dekhenge ke muwahidon ke gunah bakhsh diye gaye toh kehne lage ke hum mushrik na thay. Lekin jab munh par mohar lag jayengi aur aaza-e-badan gawahi dene lagenge toh ab kuch bhi na chhupega. Aur khud apne kartoot ke iqrari ho jayenge aur kehne lagenge kaash ke hum zameen ke barabar kar diye jaate. Aasman-o-zameen ki paidaish ki tarteeb bayan mein bhi darasal kuch ikhtilaf nahin, pehle do din mein zameen banayi gayi phir aasman ko do din mein banaya gaya phir zameen ki cheezein paani, chara, pahad, kankar, rait, jamadat, teelay waghera do din mein paida kiye, yahi maani lafz 'Dahaha' ke hain. Pas zameen ki poori paidaish chaar din mein hui aur do din mein aasman. Aur jo naam Allah Ta'ala ne apne liye muqarrar kiye hain unka bayan farmaya hai woh hamesha aisa hi rahega. Allah ka koi irada poora huay baghair nahin rehta. Pas Quran mein hargiz ikhtilaf nahin. Iska ek ek lafz Allah ki taraf se hai, zameen ko Allah Ta'ala ne do din mein paida kiya hai yani Itwar aur Peer ke din, aur zameen mein zameen ke oopar hi pahad bana diye aur zameen ko usne babarkat banaya, tum is mein beej botay ho darakht aur phal waghera is mein se paida hotay hain. Aur ahl-e-zameen ko jin cheezon ki ehtiyaaj hai woh isi mein se paida hoti rehti hain, zameen ki yeh durustagi Mangal Budh ke din hui. Chaar din mein zameen ki paidaish khatam hui. Jo log iski maloomat hasil karna chahte thay unhein poora jawab mil gaya. Zameen ke har hissay mein usne woh cheez muhayya kar di jo wahan walon ke laiq thi. Maslan asab Yaman mein, Saboori mein, Abur mein, Tayalisa Ray mein. Yahi matlab aayat ke aakhri jumlay ka hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke jis ki jo haajat thi Allah Ta'ala ne uske liye muhayya kar di. Is maani ki ta'eed Allah ke is farman se hoti hai (وَاٰتٰىكُمْ مِّنْ كُلِّ مَا سَاَلْتُمُوْهُ 34؀) (Surah Ibrahim: 34) tum ne jo jo maanga Allah ne tumhein diya. Wallahu A'lam, phir Janab-e-Bari ne aasman ki taraf tawajjah farmayi woh dhuen ki shakal mein tha, zameen ke paida kiye jaane ke waqt paani ke jo abkharaat uthay thay. Ab dono se farmaya ke ya toh mere hukm ko maano aur jo main kehta hoon ho jao khushi se ya na-khushi se, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain maslan aasmanon ko hukm hua ke suraj chand sitaray tulu kare, zameen se farmaya apni nehren jaari kar apne phal uga waghera. Dono farmanbardari ke liye raazi khushi tayyar ho gaye. Aur arz kiya ke hum ma'a is tamam makhlooq ke jisay tu rachane wala hai taabi-e-farman hain. Aur kaha gaya hai ke inhein qaim-maqam kalam karne walon ke liye kiya gaya aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke zameen ke us hissay ne kalam kiya jahan Ka'aba banaya gaya hai aur aasman ke us hissay ne kalam kiya jo theek uske oopar hai. Wallahu A'lam. Imam Hasan Basri (R.H) farmatay hain agar aasman-o-zameen itaat-guzari ka iqrar na karte toh unhein saza hoti jis ka ehsas bhi unhein hota.

Pas do din mein saaton aasman us ne bana diye yani Jumerat aur Jumma ke din. Aur har aasman mein us ne jo jo cheezein aur jaise jaise farishtay muqarrar karne chaahay muqarrar farma diye aur dunya ke aasman ko us ne sitaron se muzayyan kar diya jo zameen par chamakte rehte hain aur jo un shayateen ki nigahbani karte hain jo Mala-e-Aala ki baatein sunne ke liye oopar charhna chahte hain. Yeh tadbeer-o-andaza us Allah ka qaim karda hai jo sab par ghalib hai jo kainat ke ek ek chappay ki har chupi khuli harkat ko jaanta hai. Ibn-e-Jareer ki riwayat mein hai Yahudiyon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se aasman-o-zameen ki paidaish ki babat sawal kiya to aap ne farmaya ke Itwar aur Peer ke din Allah Ta'ala ne zameen ko paida kiya aur paharon ko Mangal ke din paida kiya aur jitne nafa'at is mein hain aur Budh ke din darakhton ko, pani ko, shehron ko aur aabadi aur veerane ko paida kiya to yeh chaar din hue. Isay bayan farma kar phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya ke Jumerat wale din aasman ko paida kiya aur Jumma ke din sitaron ko aur suraj chand ko aur farishton ko paida kiya teen sa'at ke baqi rehne tak. Phir dusri sa'at mein har cheez mein aafat daali jis se log faida uthate hain. Aur teesri mein Adam (A.S) ko paida kiya unhein jannat mein basaya, Iblees ko unhein sajda karne ka hukum diya. Aur aakhri sa'at mein wahan se nikal diya. Yahudiyon ne kaha achha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) phir is ke baad kya hua? Farmaya phir Arsh par mustawi ho gaya, unhon ne kaha sab to theek kaha lekin aakhri baat yeh kahi ke phir aaram hasil kiya. Is par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sakht naraz hue aur yeh aayat utri (وَلَــقَدْ خَلَقْنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِيْ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ ڰ وَّمَا مَسَّنَا مِنْ لُّغُوْبٍ 38؀) (Surah Qaf: 38) yani hum ne aasman-o-zameen aur jo un ke darmiyan hai sab ko chhay din mein paida kiya aur hamein koi thakan nahin hui. To un ki baaton par sabr kar. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai. Aur riwayat mein hai Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain mera haath pakar kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne mitti ko haftay ke roz paida kiya, is mein paharon ko Itwar ke din rakha, darakht Peer wale din paida kiye, makruhaat ko Mangal ke din, noor ko Budh ke din paida kiya aur janwaron ko zameen mein Jumerat ke din phaila diya aur Jumma ke din Asr ke baad Jumma ki aakhri sa'at Hazrat Adam (A.S) ko paida kiya aur kul makhlooqat poori hui. Muslim aur Nasai mein yeh hadith hai lekin yeh bhi gharaib-e-sahih mein se hai. Aur Imam Bukhari (R.H) ne Tareekh mein isay mu'allal bataya hai aur farmaya hai ke isay ba'az rawiyon ne Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se aur unhon ne isay Ka'ab Ahbar se riwayat kiya hai aur yahi zyada sahih hai.

Jis tarah sab ka paida karne wala wahi ek hai, theek usi tarah sab ka palne wala bhi wahi ek hai. Yeh tafseel yaad rahe ke aur aayaton mein zameen-o-aasman ka chhe din mein paida karna bayan hua hai, aur yahan us ki paidaish ka waqt alag bayan ho raha hai. Pas maloom hua ke pehle zameen banayi gayi. Imarat ka qaida yahi hai ke pehle bunyadein aur neeche ka hissa tayyar kiya jata hai phir oopar ka hissa aur chhat banayi jati hai. Aur Nabi Allah (ﷺ) ki sachayi par jis oontni ko Allah ne alamat banaya tha us ki kochein kaat dein. Pas un par bhi azab-e-Allah baras para.

Ek zabardast kaleje phaad dene wali chinghaar aur dil paash paash kar dene wale zalzale ne zillat-o-tauheen ke saath un ke kartooton ka badla liya. Un mein jitne woh log thay jinhein Allah ki zaat par imaan tha, nabiyon ki tasdeeq karte thay, dilon mein Allah Ta'ala ka khauf rakhte thay, unhein hum ne bacha liya, unhein zara sa bhi zarar na pahuncha aur apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath zillat-o-tauheen se aur azaab-e-Allah se najaat pa li.

Insaan apna dushman aap hai. Ya'ni in mushrikon se kaho ke Qayamat ke din un ka hashr Jahannam ki taraf hoga aur darogha-e-Jahannam un sab ko jama karenge jaise farman hai (Wa nasooqul mujrimeena ila Jahannama wirda) (19. Maryam: 86) ya'ni gunahgaron ko sakht pyaas ki halat mein Jahannam ki taraf haank le jayenge. Unhein Jahannam ke kinare khada kardiya jayega. Aur un ke a'za-e-badan aur kaan aur aankhein aur post un ke a'maal ki gawahiyaan dengi. Tamam agle pichle uyub khul jayenge har uzw-e-badan pukaar uthega ke mujh se is ne yeh yeh gunah kiya, us waqt yeh apne a'za ki taraf mutawajja ho kar unhein malamat karenge. Ke tum ne hamare khilaf gawahi kyun di? Woh kahenge Allah Ta'ala ki hukm baja-awari ke matahat us ne hamein bolne ki taqat di aur hum ne sach sach keh sunaya. Wohi toh tumhara ibtida-e-paida karne wala hai usi ne har cheez ko zaban ata farmayi hai. Khaliq ki mukhalifat aur us ke hukm ki khilaf warzi kaun karsakta hai? Bazzar mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek martaba muskuraye ya hans diye phir farmaya tum meri hansi ki wajah daryaft nahin karte? Sahaba ne kaha farmayiye kya wajah hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Qayamat ke din banda apne Rabb se jhagdega. Kahega ke Aye Allah kya tera wa'da nahin ke tu zulm na karega? Allah Ta'ala iqrar karega toh banda kahega ke main toh apni bad-a'maliyon par kisi ki shahadat qabool nahin karta. Allah farmayega kya meri aur mere buzurg farishton ki shahadat nakafi hai? Lekin phir bhi woh baar baar apni hi kehta chala jayega. Pas itmam-e-hujjat ke liye us ki zaban band kardi jayegi aur us ke a'za-e-badan se kaha jayega ke is ne jo jo kiya tha us ki gawahi tum do. Jab woh saaf saaf aur sachi gawahi de denge toh yeh unhein malamat karega aur kahega ke main toh tumhare hi bachao ke liye lad jhagad raha tha. (Muslim, Nasai waghera). Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) farmate hain kafir-o-munafiq ko hisab ke liye bulaya jayega us ke a'maal us ke samne pesh honge toh qasmein kha kha kar inkar karega aur kahega Aye Allah tere farishton ne woh likh liya hai jo main ne hargiz nahin kiya farishte kahenge falan din falan jagah tu ne falan a'mal nahin kiya? Yeh kahega Aye Allah teri izzat ki qasam main ne hargiz nahin kiya. Ab munh par mohar maar di jayegi aur a'za-e-badan gawahi denge sab se pehle us ki dahni raan bolegi. (Ibn Abi Hatim). Abu Ya'la mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Qayamat ke din kafir ke samne us ki bad-a'maliyan layi jayengi toh woh inkar karega aur jhagadne lagega. Allah Ta'ala farmayega yeh hain tere padosi jo shahid hain. Yeh kahega sab jhoote hain. Farmayega yeh hain tere kunbe qabile wale jo gawah hain kahega yeh bhi sab jhoote hain. Allah un se qasam dilwayega, woh qasam khayenge lekin yeh inkar hi karega. Sab ko Allah chup kara dega aur khud un ki zabanein un ke khilaf gawahi dengi phir unhein Jahannam wasil kardiya jayega.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain Qayamat ke din ek waqt toh woh hoga ke na kisi ko bolne ki ijazat hogi na uzr-e-mazrat karne ki. Phir jab ijazat di jayegi toh bolne lagenge aur jhagde karenge aur inkar karenge aur jhooti qasmein khayenge. Phir gawahon ko laya jayega aakhir zubanein band ho jayengi aur khud aaza-e-badan hath paon waghera gawahi denge. Phir zubanein khol di jayengi toh apne aaza-e-badan ko malamat karenge woh jawab denge ke hamein Allah ne quwwat-e-goyai di aur humne sahih sahih kaha pas zabani iqrar bhi ho jayega. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Rafi Abu-ul-Hasan se marwi hai ke apne kartoot ke inkar par zaban itni moti ho jayegi ke bola na jayega. Phir jism ke aaza ko hukum hoga tum bolo toh har ek apna apna amal bata dega kaan, aankh, khaal, sharm-gah, hath, paon waghera. Aur bhi isi tarah ki bahut si riwayatein Surah Yaseen ki aayat (AL-YAUMA NAKHTIMU 'ALA AFWAHIM WA TUKALLIMUNA AIDI-HIM WA TASH-HADU ARJULU-HUM BIMA KANU YAKSIBOON) (Surah Yaseen: 65) ki tafsir mein guzar chuki hain. Jinhein dobara warid karne ki zaroorat nahin. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah R.A farmate hain jab hum samundar ki hijrat se wapas aaye toh Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ne ek din hum se poocha tumne Habsha ki sarzameen par koi ta'ajjub-khez baat dekhi ho toh sunao. Is par ek naujawan ne kaha ek martaba hum wahan baithe hue thay. Unke ulama ki ek budhiya aurat ek pani ka ghada sar par liye hue aa rahi thi unhi mein se ek jawan ne use dhakka diya jis se woh gir padi aur ghada toot gaya. Woh uthi aur us shakhs ki taraf dekh kar kehne lagi makkar tujhe iska haal us waqt maloom hoga jabke Allah Ta'ala apni kursi sajayega aur sab agle pichlon ko jama karega aur hath paon gawahiyaan denge. Aur ek ek amal khul jayega us waqt tera aur mera faisla bhi ho jayega. Yeh sun kar Huzoor ﷺ farmane lage usne sach kaha usne sach kaha is qoum ko Allah Ta'ala kis tarah paak kare jis mein zor-awar se kamzor ka badla na liya jaye? Yeh hadith is sanad se ghareeb hai. Ibn-e-Abi Dunya mein yahi riwayat dusri sanad se bhi marwi hai, jab yeh apne aaza ko malamat karenge toh aaza jawab dete hue yeh bhi kahenge ke tumhare a'maal darasal kuch posheeda na thay Allah ke dekhte hue uske samne tum kufr-o-ma'asi mein mustaghraq rehte thay aur kuch parwah nahin karte thay. Kyunke tum samjhe hue thay ke hamare bahut se a'maal us se makhfi hain, isi fasid khayal ne tumhein talaf aur barbad kar diya aur aaj ke din tum barbad ho gaye. Muslim, Tirmidhi waghera mein Hazrat Abdullah R.A se marwi hai ke main Ka'batullah ke parde mein chupa hua tha jo teen shakhs aaye bade pet aur kam-aql wale ek ne kaha kyun ji hum jo bolte chalte hain use Allah sunta hai? Dusre ne jawab diya agar unchi awaz se bolein toh toh sunta hai aur ahista awaz se baatein karein toh nahin sunta.

Dusre ne kaha agar kuch sunta hai toh sab sunta hoga main ne aakar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh waqia bayan kiya is par aayat (وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْـتَتِرُوْنَ اَنْ يَّشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَآ اَبْصَارُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُوْدُكُمْ وَلٰكِنْ ظَنَنْتُمْ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيْرًا مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ 22؀) (41-Fussilat: 22), nazil hui. Abdur Razzaq mein hai munh band hone ke baad sab se pehle paon aur haath bolenge. Hazrat Hasan (R.A) itna farma kar kuch ta'ammul karke farmane lage jis ka jaisa guman Allah ke saath hota nek zann hota hai woh aamal bhi achhe karta hai aur kafir-o-munafiq chunke Allah ke saath bad-zann hote hain woh aamal bhi bad karte hain. Phir aap ne yahi aayat tilawat farmayi. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki marfoo hadith mein hai tum mein se koi shakhs na mare magar is halat mein ke woh Allah ke saath nek zann ho. Jin logon ne Allah ke saath bure khayalat rakhe Allah ne unhein teh-o-bala kar diya. Phir yahi aayat aap ne padhi, aag-e-jahannam mein sabr se pade rehna aur be-sabri karna un ke liye yaksan hai. Yaqeenan hum be-raah thay. Ae Allah ab tu yahan se nijat de. Agar aisa karein toh phir hamein hamare zulm ki saza dena. Lekin Janab-e-Bari ki taraf se jawab aayega ke ab yeh mansoobay be-sood hain. Jinhein dobara warid karne ki zaroorat nahin. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah R.A farmate hain jab hum samundar ki hijrat se wapas aaye toh Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ne ek din hum se poocha tumne Habsha ki sarzameen par koi ta'ajjub-khez baat dekhi ho toh sunao. Is par ek naujawan ne kaha ek martaba hum wahan baithe hue thay. Unke ulama ki ek budhiya aurat ek pani ka ghada sar par liye hue aa rahi thi unhi mein se ek jawan ne use dhakka diya jis se woh gir padi aur ghada toot gaya. Woh uthi aur us shakhs ki taraf dekh kar kehne lagi makkar tujhe iska haal us waqt maloom hoga jabke Allah Ta'ala apni kursi sajayega aur sab agle pichlon ko jama karega aur hath paon gawahiyaan denge. Aur ek ek amal khul jayega us waqt tera aur mera faisla bhi ho jayega. Yeh sun kar Huzoor ﷺ farmane lage usne sach kaha usne sach kaha is qoum ko Allah Ta'ala kis tarah paak kare jis mein zor-awar se kamzor ka badla na liya jaye? Yeh hadith is sanad se ghareeb hai. Ibn-e-Abi Dunya mein yahi riwayat dusri sanad se bhi marwi hai, jab yeh apne aaza ko malamat karenge toh aaza jawab dete hue yeh bhi kahenge ke tumhare a'maal darasal kuch posheeda na thay Allah ke dekhte hue uske samne tum kufr-o-ma'asi mein mustaghraq rehte thay aur kuch parwah nahin karte thay. Kyunke tum samjhe hue thay ke hamare bahut se a'maal us se makhfi hain, isi fasid khayal ne tumhein talaf aur barbad kar diya aur aaj ke din tum barbad ho gaye. Dusre ne jawab diya agar unchi awaz se bolein toh toh sunta hai aur ahista awaz se baatein karein toh nahin sunta.

Dusre ne kaha agar kuch sunta hai toh sab sunta hoga main ne aakar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh waqia bayan kiya is par aayat (وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْـتَتِرُوْنَ اَنْ يَّشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَآ اَبْصَارُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُوْدُكُمْ وَلٰكِنْ ظَنَنْتُمْ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيْرًا مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ 22؀) (41-Fussilat: 22), nazil hui. Abdur Razzaq mein hai munh band hone ke baad sab se pehle paon aur haath bolenge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Janab-e-Bari Azza Ismuhu ka irshad hai ke mere saath mera banda jo guman karta hai main us ke saath wahi mamla karta hoon aur jab woh mujhe pukarta hai main us ke saath hota hoon. Hazrat Hasan (R.A) itna farma kar kuch ta'ammul karke farmane lage jis ka jaisa guman Allah ke saath hota nek zann hota hai woh aamal bhi achhe karta hai aur kafir-o-munafiq chunke Allah ke saath bad-zann hote hain woh aamal bhi bad karte hain. Phir aap ne yahi aayat tilawat farmayi. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki marfoo hadith mein hai tum mein se koi shakhs na mare magar is halat mein ke woh Allah ke saath nek zann ho. Dhutkare hue yahin pade raho khabardar jo mujh se baat ki.

Abdur Razzaq mein hai munh band hone ke baad sab se pehle paon aur haath bolenge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Janab-e-Bari Azza Ismuhu ka irshad hai ke mere saath mera banda jo guman karta hai main us ke saath wahi mamla karta hoon aur jab woh mujhe pukarta hai main us ke saath hota hoon. Hazrat Hasan (R.A) itna farma kar kuch ta'ammul karke farmane lage jis ka jaisa guman Allah ke saath hota nek zann hota hai woh aamal bhi achhe karta hai aur kafir-o-munafiq chunke Allah ke saath bad-zann hote hain woh aamal bhi bad karte hain. Phir aap ne yahi aayat tilawat farmayi. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki marfoo hadith mein hai tum mein se koi shakhs na mare magar is halat mein ke woh Allah ke saath nek zann ho. Jin logon ne Allah ke saath bure khayalat rakhe Allah ne unhein teh-o-bala kar diya. Phir yahi aayat aap ne padhi, aag-e-jahannam mein sabr se pade rehna aur be-sabri karna un ke liye yaksan hai. Na un ki uzr-e-ma'zarat maqbool na un ke gunah maaf. Yeh duniya ki taraf agar lautna chahein toh woh raah bhi band jaise aur jagah hai jahannami kahenge ae Allah hum par hamari badbakhti chha gayi. Yaqeenan hum be-raah thay. Ae Allah ab tu yahan se nijat de. Agar aisa karein toh phir hamein hamare zulm ki saza dena. Lekin Janab-e-Bari ki taraf se jawab aayega ke ab yeh mansoobay be-sood hain. Dhutkare hue yahin pade raho khabardar jo mujh se baat ki.

Insaan apna dushman aap hai. Ya'ni in mushrikon se kaho ke Qayamat ke din un ka hashr Jahannam ki taraf hoga aur darogha-e-Jahannam un sab ko jama karenge jaise farman hai (Wa nasooqul mujrimeena ila Jahannama wirda) (19. Maryam: 86) ya'ni gunahgaron ko sakht pyaas ki halat mein Jahannam ki taraf haank le jayenge. Unhein Jahannam ke kinare khada kardiya jayega. Aur un ke a'za-e-badan aur kaan aur aankhein aur post un ke a'maal ki gawahiyaan dengi. Tamam agle pichle uyub khul jayenge har uzw-e-badan pukaar uthega ke mujh se is ne yeh yeh gunah kiya, us waqt yeh apne a'za ki taraf mutawajja ho kar unhein malamat karenge. Ke tum ne hamare khilaf gawahi kyun di? Woh kahenge Allah Ta'ala ki hukm baja-awari ke matahat us ne hamein bolne ki taqat di aur hum ne sach sach keh sunaya. Wohi toh tumhara ibtida-e-paida karne wala hai usi ne har cheez ko zaban ata farmayi hai. Khaliq ki mukhalifat aur us ke hukm ki khilaf warzi kaun karsakta hai? Bazzar mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek martaba muskuraye ya hans diye phir farmaya tum meri hansi ki wajah daryaft nahin karte? Sahaba ne kaha farmayiye kya wajah hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Qayamat ke din banda apne Rabb se jhagdega. Kahega ke Aye Allah kya tera wa'da nahin ke tu zulm na karega? Allah Ta'ala iqrar karega toh banda kahega ke main toh apni bad-a'maliyon par kisi ki shahadat qabool nahin karta. Allah farmayega kya meri aur mere buzurg farishton ki shahadat nakafi hai? Lekin phir bhi woh baar baar apni hi kehta chala jayega. Pas itmam-e-hujjat ke liye us ki zaban band kardi jayegi aur us ke a'za-e-badan se kaha jayega ke is ne jo jo kiya tha us ki gawahi tum do. Jab woh saaf saaf aur sachi gawahi de denge toh yeh unhein malamat karega aur kahega ke main toh tumhare hi bachao ke liye lad jhagad raha tha. (Muslim, Nasai waghera). Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) farmate hain kafir-o-munafiq ko hisab ke liye bulaya jayega us ke a'maal us ke samne pesh honge toh qasmein kha kha kar inkar karega aur kahega Aye Allah tere farishton ne woh likh liya hai jo main ne hargiz nahin kiya farishte kahenge falan din falan jagah tu ne falan a'mal nahin kiya? Yeh kahega Aye Allah teri izzat ki qasam main ne hargiz nahin kiya. Ab munh par mohar maar di jayegi aur a'za-e-badan gawahi denge sab se pehle us ki dahni raan bolegi. (Ibn Abi Hatim). Abu Ya'la mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Qayamat ke din kafir ke samne us ki bad-a'maliyan layi jayengi toh woh inkar karega aur jhagadne lagega. Allah Ta'ala farmayega yeh hain tere padosi jo shahid hain. Yeh kahega sab jhoote hain. Farmayega yeh hain tere kunbe qabile wale jo gawah hain kahega yeh bhi sab jhoote hain. Allah un se qasam dilwayega, woh qasam khayenge lekin yeh inkar hi karega. Sab ko Allah chup kara dega aur khud un ki zabanein un ke khilaf gawahi dengi phir unhein Jahannam wasil kardiya jayega.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain Qayamat ke din ek waqt toh woh hoga ke na kisi ko bolne ki ijazat hogi na uzr-e-mazrat karne ki. Phir jab ijazat di jayegi toh bolne lagenge aur jhagde karenge aur inkar karenge aur jhooti qasmein khayenge. Phir gawahon ko laya jayega aakhir zubanein band ho jayengi aur khud aaza-e-badan hath paon waghera gawahi denge. Phir zubanein khol di jayengi toh apne aaza-e-badan ko malamat karenge woh jawab denge ke hamein Allah ne quwwat-e-goyai di aur humne sahih sahih kaha pas zabani iqrar bhi ho jayega. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Rafi Abu-ul-Hasan se marwi hai ke apne kartoot ke inkar par zaban itni moti ho jayegi ke bola na jayega. Phir jism ke aaza ko hukum hoga tum bolo toh har ek apna apna amal bata dega kaan, aankh, khaal, sharm-gah, hath, paon waghera. Aur bhi isi tarah ki bahut si riwayatein Surah Yaseen ki aayat (AL-YAUMA NAKHTIMU 'ALA AFWAHIM WA TUKALLIMUNA AIDI-HIM WA TASH-HADU ARJULU-HUM BIMA KANU YAKSIBOON) (Surah Yaseen: 65) ki tafsir mein guzar chuki hain. Jinhein dobara warid karne ki zaroorat nahin. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah R.A farmate hain jab hum samundar ki hijrat se wapas aaye toh Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ne ek din hum se poocha tumne Habsha ki sarzameen par koi ta'ajjub-khez baat dekhi ho toh sunao. Is par ek naujawan ne kaha ek martaba hum wahan baithe hue thay. Unke ulama ki ek budhiya aurat ek pani ka ghada sar par liye hue aa rahi thi unhi mein se ek jawan ne use dhakka diya jis se woh gir padi aur ghada toot gaya. Woh uthi aur us shakhs ki taraf dekh kar kehne lagi makkar tujhe iska haal us waqt maloom hoga jabke Allah Ta'ala apni kursi sajayega aur sab agle pichlon ko jama karega aur hath paon gawahiyaan denge. Aur ek ek amal khul jayega us waqt tera aur mera faisla bhi ho jayega. Yeh sun kar Huzoor ﷺ farmane lage usne sach kaha usne sach kaha is qoum ko Allah Ta'ala kis tarah paak kare jis mein zor-awar se kamzor ka badla na liya jaye? Yeh hadith is sanad se ghareeb hai. Ibn-e-Abi Dunya mein yahi riwayat dusri sanad se bhi marwi hai, jab yeh apne aaza ko malamat karenge toh aaza jawab dete hue yeh bhi kahenge ke tumhare a'maal darasal kuch posheeda na thay Allah ke dekhte hue uske samne tum kufr-o-ma'asi mein mustaghraq rehte thay aur kuch parwah nahin karte thay. Kyunke tum samjhe hue thay ke hamare bahut se a'maal us se makhfi hain, isi fasid khayal ne tumhein talaf aur barbad kar diya aur aaj ke din tum barbad ho gaye. Muslim, Tirmidhi waghera mein Hazrat Abdullah R.A se marwi hai ke main Ka'batullah ke parde mein chupa hua tha jo teen shakhs aaye bade pet aur kam-aql wale ek ne kaha kyun ji hum jo bolte chalte hain use Allah sunta hai? Dusre ne jawab diya agar unchi awaz se bolein toh toh sunta hai aur ahista awaz se baatein karein toh nahin sunta.

Dhutkare hue yahin pade raho khabardar jo mujh se baat ki.

Aadab-e-Quran-e-Hakim. Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke mushrikeen ko usne gumrah kar diya hai aur yeh uski mashiyat aur qudrat se hai. Woh apne tamam af'aal mein hikmat wala hai. Usne kuch jinn-o-ins aise unke saath kar diye thay, jinhon ne unke bad-a'maal unhein achi surat mein dikhaye. Unhon ne samajh liya ke daur-e-maazi ke lihaz se aur aayinda aane wale zamane ke lihaz se bhi unke a'maal achay hi hain. Jaise aur aayatein hain (Wa man ya'shu 'an zikrir-Rahmani nuqayyid lahu shaitanun fahuwa lahu qareen) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 36), in par kalma-e-azab sadiq aa gaya. Jaise un logon par jo un se pehle jaise thay. Nuqsan aur ghate mein yeh aur woh yaksan ho gaye, kuffar ne aapas mein mashwara karke is par ittefaq kar liya hai ke woh Kalam-e-Allah ko nahin manenge na hi uske ahkaam ki pairwi karenge. Balkeh ek dusre se keh rakha hai ke jab Quran padha jaye to shor-o-ghul karo aur ise na suno. Taliyan bajao, seetiyan bajao, aawazein nikalo. Chunancha Quraishi yahi karte thay. Aib joi karte thay, inkar karte thay, dushmani karte thay aur ise apne ghalbe ka ba'is jante thay. Yahi haal har jahil kafir ka hai ke use Quran ka sunna acha nahin lagta. Isi liye iske bar-khilaf Allah Ta'ala ne mominon ko hukum farmaya ke (Wa iza quri'al-Qur'anu fastami'u lahu wa ansitu la'allakum turhamun) (Surah Al-A'raf: 204) jab Quran padha jaye to tum suno aur chup raho taake tum par raham kiya jaye. In kafiron ko dhamkaya ja raha hai ke Quran-e-Kareem se mukhalifat karne ki bina par unhein sakht saza di jayegi aur unki bad-amali ka maza unhein zaroor chakhaya jayega. In Allah ke dushmanon ka badla dozakh ki aag hai, jis mein unke liye hamesha ka ghar hai. Yeh us ka badla hai jo woh Allah ki aayat ka inkar karte thay. Iske baad aayat ka matlab Hazrat Ali (R.A) se marwi hai ke jinn se murad Iblees aur ins se murad Hazrat Adam (A.S) ka woh ladka hai jisne apne bhai ko maar dala tha. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Iblees to har mushrik ko pukarega aur Hazrat Adam (A.S) ka yeh ladka har kabira gunah karne wale ko pukarega. Pas Iblees shirk ki taraf aur tamam gunahon ki taraf logon ko dawat dene wala hai aur awwal-e-rasool Hazrat Adam (A.S) ka yeh ladka jo apne bhai ka qatil hai. Chunancha hadith mein hai roo-e-zameen par jo qatl-e-na-haq hota hai uska gunah Hazrat Adam (A.S) ke is pehle farzand par bhi hota hai kyunke qatl-e-beja ka shuru karne wala yeh hai. Pas kuffar Qayamat ke din jinn-o-ins jo unhein gumrah karne wale thay unhein neeche ke tabqe mein dakhil karana chahenge taake unhein sakht azab hon. Woh dark-e-asfal mein chale jayenge aur un se zyada saza bhugtenge. Surah A'raf mein bhi yeh bayan guzar chuka hai ke yeh manne wale jin ki mante thay unke liye Qayamat ke din dohre azab ki darkhwast karenge jis par kaha jayega ke har ek dogune azab mein hi hai lekin tum be-shaoor ho. Ya'ni har ek ko uske a'maal ke mutabiq saza ho rahi hai.

Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Allazeena kafaroo wa saddoo 'an sabeelillahi adalla a'malahum) (Surah Muhammad: 1). Ya'ni jin logon ne kufr kiya aur Allah ki raah se roka unhein hum un ke fasaad ki wajah se azaab par azaab denge.

Usne kuch jinn-o-ins aise unke saath kar diye thay, jinhon ne unke bad-a'maal unhein achi surat mein dikhaye. Unhon ne samajh liya ke daur-e-maazi ke lihaz se aur aayinda aane wale zamane ke lihaz se bhi unke a'maal achay hi hain. Jaise aur aayatein hain (Wa man ya'shu 'an zikrir-Rahmani nuqayyid lahu shaitanun fahuwa lahu qareen) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 36), in par kalma-e-azab sadiq aa gaya. Jaise un logon par jo un se pehle jaise thay. Nuqsan aur ghate mein yeh aur woh yaksan ho gaye, kuffar ne aapas mein mashwara karke is par ittefaq kar liya hai ke woh Kalam-e-Allah ko nahin manenge na hi uske ahkaam ki pairwi karenge. Balkeh ek dusre se keh rakha hai ke jab Quran padha jaye to shor-o-ghul karo aur ise na suno. Taliyan bajao, seetiyan bajao, aawazein nikalo. Chunancha Quraishi yahi karte thay. Aib joi karte thay, inkar karte thay, dushmani karte thay aur ise apne ghalbe ka ba'is jante thay. Yahi haal har jahil kafir ka hai ke use Quran ka sunna acha nahin lagta. Isi liye iske bar-khilaf Allah Ta'ala ne mominon ko hukum farmaya ke (Wa iza quri'al-Qur'anu fastami'u lahu wa ansitu la'allakum turhamun) (Surah Al-A'raf: 204) jab Quran padha jaye to tum suno aur chup raho taake tum par raham kiya jaye. In kafiron ko dhamkaya ja raha hai ke Quran-e-Kareem se mukhalifat karne ki bina par unhein sakht saza di jayegi aur unki bad-amali ka maza unhein zaroor chakhaya jayega. In Allah ke dushmanon ka badla dozakh ki aag hai, jis mein unke liye hamesha ka ghar hai. Yeh us ka badla hai jo woh Allah ki aayat ka inkar karte thay. Iske baad aayat ka matlab Hazrat Ali (R.A) se marwi hai ke jinn se murad Iblees aur ins se murad Hazrat Adam (A.S) ka woh ladka hai jisne apne bhai ko maar dala tha. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Iblees to har mushrik ko pukarega aur Hazrat Adam (A.S) ka yeh ladka har kabira gunah karne wale ko pukarega. Pas Iblees shirk ki taraf aur tamam gunahon ki taraf logon ko dawat dene wala hai aur awwal-e-rasool Hazrat Adam (A.S) ka yeh ladka jo apne bhai ka qatil hai. Chunancha hadith mein hai roo-e-zameen par jo qatl-e-na-haq hota hai uska gunah Hazrat Adam (A.S) ke is pehle farzand par bhi hota hai kyunke qatl-e-beja ka shuru karne wala yeh hai. Pas kuffar Qayamat ke din jinn-o-ins jo unhein gumrah karne wale thay unhein neeche ke tabqe mein dakhil karana chahenge taake unhein sakht azab hon. Woh dark-e-asfal mein chale jayenge aur un se zyada saza bhugtenge. Surah A'raf mein bhi yeh bayan guzar chuka hai ke yeh manne wale jin ki mante thay unke liye Qayamat ke din dohre azab ki darkhwast karenge jis par kaha jayega ke har ek dogune azab mein hi hai lekin tum be-shaoor ho. Ya'ni har ek ko uske a'maal ke mutabiq saza ho rahi hai.

Istiqamat aur is ka anjam. Jin logon ne zabani Allah Ta'ala ke Rabb hone ka yani us ki tauheed ka iqrar kiya. Phir is par jame rahe yani farman-e-Ilahi ke matehat apni zindagi guzari. Chunancha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is ayat ki tilawat farma kar wazahat ki ke bahut logon ne Allah ke Rabb hone ka iqrar karke phir kufr kar liya. Jo marte dam tak is baat par jama raha woh hai jis ne is par istiqamat ki. (Nasa'i waghera). Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ke samne jab is ayat ki tilawat hui to aap ne farmaya "Is se murad kalma parh kar phir kabhi bhi shirk na karne wale hain." Ek riwayat mein hai ke Khalifatul Muslimeen ne ek martaba logon se is ayat ki tafseer pochi to unhon ne kaha ke istiqamat se murad gunah na karna hai, aap ne farmaya tum ne ise ghalat samjhaya. Is se murad Allah ki uluhiyat ka iqrar karke phir dusre ki taraf kabhi bhi iltifat na karna hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se sawal hota hai ke Quran mein hukm aur jaza ke lihaz se sab se zyada asan ayat konsi hai? Aap ne is ayat ki tilawat ki ke tauheed-e-Allah par ta-umar qaim rehna. Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ne mimbar par is ayat ki tilawat karke farmaya wallah woh log hain jo Allah ki ita'at par jam jate hain aur lomri ki chaal nahin chalte ke kabhi idhar kabhi udhar. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain fara'iz-e-Allah ki adaigi karte hain. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) yeh dua manga karte the.. Ae Allah tu hamara Rabb hai hamein istiqamat aur pukhtagi ata farma. Istiqamat se murad deen aur amal ka khuloos. Hazrat Abu Aliyah (R.H) ne kaha hai ek shakhs ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ke mujhe Islam ka koi aisa amr batlayiye ke phir kisi se daryaft karne ki zaroorat na rahe. Aap ne farmaya zaban se iqrar kar ke main Allah par iman laya aur phir is par jam ja. Us ne phir pucha acha yeh to amal hua ab bacho kis cheez se? To aap ne zaban ki taraf ishara farmaya. (Muslim waghera). Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ise Hasan Sahih batlate hain, un ke paas un ki maut ke waqt farishtay aate hain aur unhein bashartein sunate hain ke tum ab akhirat ki manzil ki taraf ja rahe ho be-khauf raho tum par wahan koi khatka nahin. Tum apne peeche jo duniya chhore ja rahe ho is par bhi koi gham-o-ranj na karo. Tumhare ahl-o-ayal, maal-o-mata'a ki deen-o-diyanat ki hifazat hamare zimme hai. Hum tumhare khalifa hain. Tumhein hum khush khabri sunate hain ke tum jannati ho tumhein sacha aur sahih wada diya gaya tha woh pura ho kar rahe ga. Pas woh apne inteqal ke waqt khush khush jate hain ke tamam buraiyon se bache aur tamam bhulaiyan hasil huin. Hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain. Momin ki rooh se farishtay kehte hain ae pak rooh jo pak jism mein thi chal Allah ki bakhshish in'am aur us ki ne'mat ki taraf. Chal us Allah ke paas jo tujh par naraz nahin. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke jab musalman apni qabron se uthenge isi waqt farishtay un ke paas ayenge aur unhein bashartein sunayenge.

Hazrat Sabit jab is surat ko parhte hue is ayat tak pohanche to thehar gaye aur farmaya hamein yeh khabar mili hai ke momin banda jab qabr se uthe ga to woh do farishtay jo duniya mein us ke sath thay us ke paas aatay hain aur us se kehte hain dar nahin, ghabra nahin, ghamgeen na ho, tu jannati hai, khush ho ja, tujh se Allah ke jo waday thay pooray honge. Gharz khauf aman se badal jaye ga, aankhein thandi hongi, dil mutma'in ho jaye ga. Qayamat ka tamam khauf, dehshat aur wehshat door ho jaye gi. Aamal-e-Saliha ka badla apni aankhon dekhe ga aur khush hoga. Al-hasil maut ke waqt, qabr mein aur qabr se uthte hue har waqt malaika-e-rahmat us ke sath rahen ge aur har waqt bashartein sunatay rahen ge, un se farishtay yeh bhi kahen ge ke zindagani-e-duniya mein bhi hum tumhare rafeeq aur wali thay, tumhein neki ki raah samjhatay thay, khair ki rehnumai karte thay, tumhari hifazat karte rehte thay, theek isi tarah aakhirat mein bhi hum tumhare sath rahen ge, tumhari wehshat aur dehshat door karte rahen ge, qabr mein, hashr mein, maidan-e-qayamat mein, pul-e-sirat par, gharz har jagah hum tumhare rafeeq aur dost aur sathi hain. Naimaton wali jannaton mein pohancha dene tak tum se alag na honge, wahan jo tum chaho ge mile ga, jo khwahish hogi poori hogi, yeh mehmani, yeh ata, yeh inaam, yeh ziyafat us Allah ki taraf se hai jo bakhshne wala aur meherbani karne wala hai. Us ka lutf-o-rahm, us ki bakhshish aur karam bohat wasee hai. Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab aur Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ki mulaqat hoti hai to Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmatay hain Allah Ta'ala hum dono ko jannat ke bazaar mein milaye. Is par Hazrat Saeed ne poocha kya jannat mein bhi bazaar honge? Farmaya haan, mujhe Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khabar di hai ke jannati jab jannat mein jayen ge aur apne apne maratib ke mutabiq darjay payen ge to duniya ke andazay se jumma walay din unhein ek jagah jama hone ki ijazat mile gi. Jab sab jama ho jayen ge to Allah Ta'ala un par tajalli farmaye ga, us ka arsh zahir hoga. Woh sab jannat ke bagheeche mein noor, lulu, yaqoot, zabarjad aur sonay chandi ke minbaron par baithen ge, jo nekiyon ke aitbar se kam darjay ke hain lekin jannati hone ke aitbar se koi kisi se kamtar nahin, woh mushk aur kafoor ke teelon par honge lekin apni jagah itnay khush honge ke kursi walon ko apne se afzal majlis mein nahin jante honge. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmatay hain main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ke kya hum apne Rab ko dekhen ge? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan haan dekho ge. Aadhe din ke suraj aur chaudhween raat ke chand ko jis tarah saaf dekhte ho isi tarah Allah Ta'ala ko dekho ge. Is majlis mein ek ek se Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala baat cheet kare ga yahan tak ke kisi se farmaye ga, yaad hai falan din tum ne falan ka khilaf kiya tha? Woh kahe ga kyun Janab-e-Bari! Tu to woh khata maaf farma chuka tha phir us ka kya zikr? Kahe ga haan theek hai, isi meri maghfirat ki wusat ki wajah se hi to is darjay par pohancha.

Yeh isi halat mein honge ke unhein ek abr dhanp le ga aur us se aisi khushbu barse gi ke kabhi kisi ne nahin soonghi thi. Phir Rabb-ul-Alameen Azzawajal farmaye ga ke utho aur main ne jo inaam-o-ikram tumhare liye tayyar kar rakhe hain unhein lo. Phir yeh sab ek bazaar mein pahunchenge jise charon taraf se farishtay ghere hue honge wahan woh cheezein dekhenge jo na kabhi dekhi thin na suni thin na kabhi khayal mein guzri thin. Jo shakhs jo cheez chahe ga le le ga khareed-o-farokht wahan na hogi. Balkay inaam hoga. Wahan tamam Ahl-e-Jannat ek dusre se mulaqat karenge ek kam darjay ka jannati aala darjay ke jannati se mulaqat kare ga to us ke libas waghera ko dekh kar jee mein khayal kare ga wahin apne jism ki taraf dekhe ga ke us se bhi achay kapray us ke hain. Kyunke wahan kisi ko koi ranj-o-gham na hoga. Ab hum sab laut kar apni apni manzilon mein jayenge wahan hamari biwiyan hamain marhaba kahengi aur kahengi ke jis waqt aap yahan se gaye tab yeh taro-tazgi aur yeh nooraniyat aap mein na thi lekin is waqt to jamal-o-khoobi aur khushbu aur tazgi bahut hi barhi hui hai. Yeh jawab denge ke haan theek hai hum aaj Allah Ta'ala ki majlis mein thay aur yaqeenan hum bahut hi barh charh gaye. (Tirmidhi waghera). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo Allah ki mulaqat ko pasand kare Allah bhi us se milne ko chahta hai aur jo Allah ki mulaqat ko bura janay Allah bhi us ki mulaqat ko napasand karta hai. Sahaba ne kaha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum to maut ko makrooh jante hain, aap ne farmaya is se murad maut ki karahiyat nahin balkay momin ki sakrat ke waqt us ke paas Allah ki taraf se khushkhabri aati hai jise sun kar us ke nazdeek Allah ki mulaqat se zyada mehboob cheez koi nahin rehti. Pas Allah bhi us ki mulaqat pasand farmata hai aur fajir ya kafir ki sakrat ke waqt jab usay us burai ki khabar di jati hai jo usay ab pahunchne wali hai to woh Allah ki mulaqat ko makrooh rakhta hai. Pas Allah bhi us ki mulaqat ko makrooh rakhta hai. Yeh hadith bilkul sahih hai aur is ki bahut si asnadein hain.

Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan haan dekho ge. Aadhe din ke suraj aur chaudhween raat ke chand ko jis tarah saaf dekhte ho isi tarah Allah Ta'ala ko dekho ge. Is majlis mein ek ek se Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala baat cheet kare ga yahan tak ke kisi se farmaye ga, yaad hai falan din tum ne falan ka khilaf kiya tha? Woh kahe ga kyun Janab-e-Bari! Tu to woh khata maaf farma chuka tha phir us ka kya zikr? Kahe ga haan theek hai, isi meri maghfirat ki wusat ki wajah se hi to is darjay par pohancha.

Yeh isi halat mein honge ke unhein ek abr dhanp le ga aur us se aisi khushbu barse gi ke kabhi kisi ne nahin soonghi thi. Phir Rabb-ul-Alameen Azzawajal farmaye ga ke utho aur main ne jo inaam-o-ikram tumhare liye tayyar kar rakhe hain unhein lo. Phir yeh sab ek bazaar mein pahunchenge jise charon taraf se farishtay ghere hue honge wahan woh cheezein dekhenge jo na kabhi dekhi thin na suni thin na kabhi khayal mein guzri thin. Jo shakhs jo cheez chahe ga le le ga khareed-o-farokht wahan na hogi. Balkay inaam hoga. Wahan tamam Ahl-e-Jannat ek dusre se mulaqat karenge ek kam darjay ka jannati aala darjay ke jannati se mulaqat kare ga to us ke libas waghera ko dekh kar jee mein khayal kare ga wahin apne jism ki taraf dekhe ga ke us se bhi achay kapray us ke hain. Kyunke wahan kisi ko koi ranj-o-gham na hoga. Ab hum sab laut kar apni apni manzilon mein jayenge wahan hamari biwiyan hamain marhaba kahengi aur kahengi ke jis waqt aap yahan se gaye tab yeh taro-tazgi aur yeh nooraniyat aap mein na thi lekin is waqt to jamal-o-khoobi aur khushbu aur tazgi bahut hi barhi hui hai. Yeh jawab denge ke haan theek hai hum aaj Allah Ta'ala ki majlis mein thay aur yaqeenan hum bahut hi barh charh gaye. (Tirmidhi waghera). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo Allah ki mulaqat ko pasand kare Allah bhi us se milne ko chahta hai aur jo Allah ki mulaqat ko bura janay Allah bhi us ki mulaqat ko napasand karta hai. Sahaba ne kaha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum to maut ko makrooh jante hain, aap ne farmaya is se murad maut ki karahiyat nahin balkay momin ki sakrat ke waqt us ke paas Allah ki taraf se khushkhabri aati hai jise sun kar us ke nazdeek Allah ki mulaqat se zyada mehboob cheez koi nahin rehti. Pas Allah bhi us ki mulaqat pasand farmata hai aur fajir ya kafir ki sakrat ke waqt jab usay us burai ki khabar di jati hai jo usay ab pahunchne wali hai to woh Allah ki mulaqat ko makrooh rakhta hai. Pas Allah bhi us ki mulaqat ko makrooh rakhta hai. Yeh hadith bilkul sahih hai aur is ki bahut si asnadein hain.

Istiqamat aur is ka anjam. Jin logon ne zabani Allah Ta'ala ke Rabb hone ka yani us ki tauheed ka iqrar kiya. Phir is par jame rahe yani farman-e-Ilahi ke matehat apni zindagi guzari. Chunancha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is ayat ki tilawat farma kar wazahat ki ke bahut logon ne Allah ke Rabb hone ka iqrar karke phir kufr kar liya. Jo marte dam tak is baat par jama raha woh hai jis ne is par istiqamat ki. (Nasa'i waghera). Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ke samne jab is ayat ki tilawat hui to aap ne farmaya "Is se murad kalma parh kar phir kabhi bhi shirk na karne wale hain." Ek riwayat mein hai ke Khalifatul Muslimeen ne ek martaba logon se is ayat ki tafseer pochi to unhon ne kaha ke istiqamat se murad gunah na karna hai, aap ne farmaya tum ne ise ghalat samjhaya. Is se murad Allah ki uluhiyat ka iqrar karke phir dusre ki taraf kabhi bhi iltifat na karna hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se sawal hota hai ke Quran mein hukm aur jaza ke lihaz se sab se zyada asan ayat konsi hai? Aap ne is ayat ki tilawat ki ke tauheed-e-Allah par ta-umar qaim rehna. Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ne mimbar par is ayat ki tilawat karke farmaya wallah woh log hain jo Allah ki ita'at par jam jate hain aur lomri ki chaal nahin chalte ke kabhi idhar kabhi udhar. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain fara'iz-e-Allah ki adaigi karte hain. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) yeh dua manga karte the.. Ae Allah tu hamara Rabb hai hamein istiqamat aur pukhtagi ata farma. Istiqamat se murad deen aur amal ka khuloos. Hazrat Abu Aliyah (R.H) ne kaha hai ek shakhs ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ke mujhe Islam ka koi aisa amr batlayiye ke phir kisi se daryaft karne ki zaroorat na rahe. Aap ne farmaya zaban se iqrar kar ke main Allah par iman laya aur phir is par jam ja. Us ne phir pucha acha yeh to amal hua ab bacho kis cheez se? To aap ne zaban ki taraf ishara farmaya. (Muslim waghera). Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ise Hasan Sahih batlate hain, un ke paas un ki maut ke waqt farishtay aate hain aur unhein bashartein sunate hain ke tum ab akhirat ki manzil ki taraf ja rahe ho be-khauf raho tum par wahan koi khatka nahin. Tum apne peeche jo duniya chhore ja rahe ho is par bhi koi gham-o-ranj na karo. Tumhare ahl-o-ayal, maal-o-mata'a ki deen-o-diyanat ki hifazat hamare zimme hai. Hum tumhare khalifa hain. Tumhein hum khush khabri sunate hain ke tum jannati ho tumhein sacha aur sahih wada diya gaya tha woh pura ho kar rahe ga. Pas woh apne inteqal ke waqt khush khush jate hain ke tamam buraiyon se bache aur tamam bhulaiyan hasil huin. Hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain. Momin ki rooh se farishtay kehte hain ae pak rooh jo pak jism mein thi chal Allah ki bakhshish in'am aur us ki ne'mat ki taraf. Chal us Allah ke paas jo tujh par naraz nahin. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke jab musalman apni qabron se uthenge isi waqt farishtay un ke paas ayenge aur unhein bashartein sunayenge.

Hazrat Sabit jab is surat ko parhte hue is ayat tak pohanche to thehar gaye aur farmaya hamein yeh khabar mili hai ke momin banda jab qabr se uthe ga to woh do farishtay jo duniya mein us ke sath thay us ke paas aatay hain aur us se kehte hain dar nahin, ghabra nahin, ghamgeen na ho, tu jannati hai, khush ho ja, tujh se Allah ke jo waday thay pooray honge. Gharz khauf aman se badal jaye ga, aankhein thandi hongi, dil mutma'in ho jaye ga. Qayamat ka tamam khauf, dehshat aur wehshat door ho jaye gi. Aamal-e-Saliha ka badla apni aankhon dekhe ga aur khush hoga. Al-hasil maut ke waqt, qabr mein aur qabr se uthte hue har waqt malaika-e-rahmat us ke sath rahen ge aur har waqt bashartein sunatay rahen ge, un se farishtay yeh bhi kahen ge ke zindagani-e-duniya mein bhi hum tumhare rafeeq aur wali thay, tumhein neki ki raah samjhatay thay, khair ki rehnumai karte thay, tumhari hifazat karte rehte thay, theek isi tarah aakhirat mein bhi hum tumhare sath rahen ge, tumhari wehshat aur dehshat door karte rahen ge, qabr mein, hashr mein, maidan-e-qayamat mein, pul-e-sirat par, gharz har jagah hum tumhare rafeeq aur dost aur sathi hain. Naimaton wali jannaton mein pohancha dene tak tum se alag na honge, wahan jo tum chaho ge mile ga, jo khwahish hogi poori hogi, yeh mehmani, yeh ata, yeh inaam, yeh ziyafat us Allah ki taraf se hai jo bakhshne wala aur meherbani karne wala hai. Us ka lutf-o-rahm, us ki bakhshish aur karam bohat wasee hai. Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyab aur Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ki mulaqat hoti hai to Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmatay hain Allah Ta'ala hum dono ko jannat ke bazaar mein milaye. Is par Hazrat Saeed ne poocha kya jannat mein bhi bazaar honge? Farmaya haan, mujhe Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khabar di hai ke jannati jab jannat mein jayen ge aur apne apne maratib ke mutabiq darjay payen ge to duniya ke andazay se jumma walay din unhein ek jagah jama hone ki ijazat mile gi. Jab sab jama ho jayen ge to Allah Ta'ala un par tajalli farmaye ga, us ka arsh zahir hoga. Tu to woh khata maaf farma chuka tha phir us ka kya zikr? Kahe ga haan theek hai, isi meri maghfirat ki wusat ki wajah se hi to is darjay par pohancha.
