Allah Ta'ala ka mehboob insaan. Farmata hai jo Allah ke bandon ko Allah ki taraf bulaye aur khud bhi neki kare, Islam qabool kare, us se zyada achi baat aur kis ki hogi? Yeh hai jis ne apne tayin nafa pahunchaya aur khalq-e-Allah ko bhi apni zaat se nafa pahunchaya. Yeh un mein nahin jo munh ke bade baatuni hote hain, jo dusron ko kehte toh hain magar khud nahin karte, yeh toh khud bhi karta hai aur dusron se bhi kehta hai. Yeh aayat aam hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sab se awla taur par is ke misdaq hain. Baaz ne kaha hai ke is ke misdaq azan dene wale hain jo nek kaar bhi hon. Chunancha Sahih Muslim mein hai, Qayamat ke din muazzin sab logon se zyada lambi gardanon wale honge. Sunan mein hai imam zamin hai aur muazzin amanatdar hai, Allah Ta'ala imamon ko rah-e-raast dikhaye aur muazzinon ko bakhshe. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Sa'ad bin Waqqas (R.A) farmate hain: Azan dene walon ka hissa Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek misl-e-jihad karne walon ke hisse ke hai. Azan-o-iqamat ke darmiyan un ki woh halat hai jaise koi jihad mein rah-e-Allah mein apne khoon mein lot-pot ho raha ho. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain agar main muazzin hota toh phir mujhe hajj-o-umre aur jihad ki itni zyada parwah na rehti. Hazrat Umar (R.A) se manqool hai: Agar main muazzin hota toh meri aarzoo poori ho jati aur main raat ke nafli qayam ki aur din ke nafli rozon ki is qadar tag-o-dau na karta. Main ne suna hai Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne teen baar muazzinon ki bakhshish ki dua mangi. Is par main ne kaha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap ne apni dua mein hamain yaad na farmaya halankeh hum azan kehne par talwarein taan lete hain, aap ne farmaya haan! Lekin ae Umar aisa zamana bhi aane wala hai ke muazzini gareeb maskeen logon tak reh jayegi. Suno Umar jin logon ka gosht-post jahannam par haram hai un mein muazzin hain. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain is aayat mein bhi muazzinon ki tareef hai, is ka 'Hayya 'alas-salah' kehna Allah ki taraf bulana hai. Ibn-e-Umar aur Ikrama farmate hain yeh aayat muazzinon ke bare mein utri hai aur yeh jo farmaya ke woh amal-e-saleh karta hai is se murad azan-o-takbeer ke darmiyan do rakat padhna hai. Jaise ke huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai: Do azanon ke darmiyan namaz hai, do azanon ke darmiyan namaz hai, do azanon ke darmiyan namaz hai jo chahe. Ek hadith mein hai ke azan-o-iqamat ke darmiyan ki dua rad nahin hoti. Sahih baat yeh hai ke aayat apne umoom ke lihaz se muazzin, ghair-muazzin har us shakhs ko shamil hai jo Allah ki taraf dawat de. Yeh yaad rahe ke aayat ke nazil hone ke waqt toh sire se azan shuru hi na thi. Is liye ke aayat Makkah mein utarti hai aur azan Madine pahunch jane ke baad muqarrar hui hai jabkeh Hazrat Abdullah bin Zaid bin Abd-e-Rabbah (R.A) ne apne khwab mein azan dete dekha aur suna, huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is ka zikr kiya toh aap ne farmaya Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ko sikhao, woh buland aawaz wale hain. Pas sahih baat yahi hai ke aayat aam hai is mein muazzin bhi shamil hain. Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) is aayat ko padh kar farmate hain yahi log Habib-e-Allah hain.

Yehi Auliya-e-Allah hain, yehi sab se zyada Allah ke pasandida hain, yehi sab se zyada Allah ke mehboob hain ke unhon ne Allah ki baatein maan lein, phir dusron se manwane lage aur apne manne mein nekiyan karte rahe aur apne Musalman hone ka elaan karte rahe. Yeh Allah ke Khalifa hain. Bhalai aur burai, neki aur badi barabar barabar nahin, balkay in mein behad farq hai. Jo tujh se burai kare to us se bhalai kar aur us ki burai ko is tarah dafa kar. Hazrat Umar R.A ka farman hai ke tere bare mein jo shakhs Allah ki nafarmani kare to tu us ke bare mein Allah ki farmabardari kar, is se barh kar koi cheez nahin. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke aisa karne se tera jaani dushman dili dost ban jayega. Is wasiyat par amal usi se hoga jo sabir ho, nafs par ikhtiyar rakhta ho aur ho bhi naseeb-dar ke deen-o-duniya ki behtari us ki taqdeer mein ho. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain, imaan walon ko Allah ka hukum hai ke woh gusse ke waqt sabr karein aur dusre ki jahalat par apni bardbari ka suboot dein aur dusre ki burai se darguzar kar lein. Aise log shaitani daao se mehfooz rehte hain aur un ke dushman bhi phir to un ke dost ban jate hain, insani shar se bachne ka tariqa. Ab shaitani shar se bachne ka tariqa bayan ho raha hai ke Allah ki taraf jhuk jaya karo, usi ne ise yeh taqat de rakhi hai ke woh dil mein wasawas paida kare aur usi ke ikhtiyar mein hai ke woh us ke shar se mehfooz rakhe. Nabi ﷺ apni namaz mein farmate the: "A'uzu billahis-Samee'il Aleemi minash-Shaitanir-Rajeem min hamzihi wa nafkhihi wa nafthihi." Pehle hum bayan kar chuke hain ke is maqam jaisa hi maqam sirf Surah Al-A'raf mein hai jahan irshad hai: (Khuzil-afwa wa'mur bil-urfi wa a'rid anil-jahileen) (Surah Al-A'raf: 199) aur Surah Al-Mu'minoon ki aayat (Idfa' billati hiya ahsanus-sayyi'ah) (Surah Al-Mu'minoon: 96) mein hukum hua hai ke darguzar karne ki aadat daalo aur Allah ki panah mein aa jaya karo, burai ka badla bhalai se diya karo waghera.

Hazrat Umar R.A ka farman hai ke tere bare mein jo shakhs Allah ki nafarmani kare to tu us ke bare mein Allah ki farmabardari kar, is se barh kar koi cheez nahin. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke aisa karne se tera jaani dushman dili dost ban jayega. Is wasiyat par amal usi se hoga jo sabir ho, nafs par ikhtiyar rakhta ho aur ho bhi naseeb-dar ke deen-o-duniya ki behtari us ki taqdeer mein ho. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain, imaan walon ko Allah ka hukum hai ke woh gusse ke waqt sabr karein aur dusre ki jahalat par apni bardbari ka suboot dein aur dusre ki burai se darguzar kar lein. Aise log shaitani daao se mehfooz rehte hain aur un ke dushman bhi phir to un ke dost ban jate hain, insani shar se bachne ka tariqa. Ab shaitani shar se bachne ka tariqa bayan ho raha hai ke Allah ki taraf jhuk jaya karo, usi ne ise yeh taqat de rakhi hai ke woh dil mein wasawas paida kare aur usi ke ikhtiyar mein hai ke woh us ke shar se mehfooz rakhe. Nabi ﷺ apni namaz mein farmate the: "A'uzu billahis-Samee'il Aleemi minash-Shaitanir-Rajeem min hamzihi wa nafkhihi wa nafthihi." Pehle hum bayan kar chuke hain ke is maqam jaisa hi maqam sirf Surah Al-A'raf mein hai jahan irshad hai: (Khuzil-afwa wa'mur bil-urfi wa a'rid anil-jahileen) (Surah Al-A'raf: 199) aur Surah Al-Mu'minoon ki aayat (Idfa' billati hiya ahsanus-sayyi'ah) (Surah Al-Mu'minoon: 96) mein hukum hua hai ke darguzar karne ki aadat daalo aur Allah ki panah mein aa jaya karo, burai ka badla bhalai se diya karo waghera.

Allah Ta'ala ka mehboob insaan. Farmata hai jo Allah ke bandon ko Allah ki taraf bulaye aur khud bhi neki kare, Islam qabool kare, us se zyada achi baat aur kis ki hogi? Yeh hai jis ne apne tayin nafa pahunchaya aur khalq-e-Allah ko bhi apni zaat se nafa pahunchaya. Yeh un mein nahin jo munh ke bade baatuni hote hain, jo dusron ko kehte toh hain magar khud nahin karte, yeh toh khud bhi karta hai aur dusron se bhi kehta hai. Yeh aayat aam hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sab se awla taur par is ke misdaq hain. Baaz ne kaha hai ke is ke misdaq azan dene wale hain jo nek kaar bhi hon. Chunancha Sahih Muslim mein hai, Qayamat ke din muazzin sab logon se zyada lambi gardanon wale honge. Sunan mein hai imam zamin hai aur muazzin amanatdar hai, Allah Ta'ala imamon ko rah-e-raast dikhaye aur muazzinon ko bakhshe. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Sa'ad bin Waqqas (R.A) farmate hain: Azan dene walon ka hissa Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek misl-e-jihad karne walon ke hisse ke hai. Azan-o-iqamat ke darmiyan un ki woh halat hai jaise koi jihad mein rah-e-Allah mein apne khoon mein lot-pot ho raha ho. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain agar main muazzin hota toh phir mujhe hajj-o-umre aur jihad ki itni zyada parwah na rehti. Hazrat Umar (R.A) se manqool hai: Agar main muazzin hota toh meri aarzoo poori ho jati aur main raat ke nafli qayam ki aur din ke nafli rozon ki is qadar tag-o-dau na karta. Main ne suna hai Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne teen baar muazzinon ki bakhshish ki dua mangi. Is par main ne kaha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap ne apni dua mein hamain yaad na farmaya halankeh hum azan kehne par talwarein taan lete hain, aap ne farmaya haan! Lekin ae Umar aisa zamana bhi aane wala hai ke muazzini gareeb maskeen logon tak reh jayegi. Suno Umar jin logon ka gosht-post jahannam par haram hai un mein muazzin hain. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain is aayat mein bhi muazzinon ki tareef hai, is ka 'Hayya 'alas-salah' kehna Allah ki taraf bulana hai. Ibn-e-Umar aur Ikrama farmate hain yeh aayat muazzinon ke bare mein utri hai aur yeh jo farmaya ke woh amal-e-saleh karta hai is se murad azan-o-takbeer ke darmiyan do rakat padhna hai. Jaise ke huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai: Do azanon ke darmiyan namaz hai, do azanon ke darmiyan namaz hai, do azanon ke darmiyan namaz hai jo chahe. Ek hadith mein hai ke azan-o-iqamat ke darmiyan ki dua rad nahin hoti. Sahih baat yeh hai ke aayat apne umoom ke lihaz se muazzin, ghair-muazzin har us shakhs ko shamil hai jo Allah ki taraf dawat de. Yeh yaad rahe ke aayat ke nazil hone ke waqt toh sire se azan shuru hi na thi. Is liye ke aayat Makkah mein utarti hai aur azan Madine pahunch jane ke baad muqarrar hui hai jabkeh Hazrat Abdullah bin Zaid bin Abd-e-Rabbah (R.A) ne apne khwab mein azan dete dekha aur suna, huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is ka zikr kiya toh aap ne farmaya Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ko sikhao, woh buland aawaz wale hain. Pas sahih baat yahi hai ke aayat aam hai is mein muazzin bhi shamil hain. Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) is aayat ko padh kar farmate hain yahi log Habib-e-Allah hain.

Makhlooq ko nahin Khaliq ko sajda karo. Allah Ta'ala apni makhlooq ko apni azeem-ush-shan qudrat aur bemisaal taqat dikhata hai ke woh jo karna chahe kar dalta hai. Suraj, chand, din, raat uski qudrat-e-kamilah ke nishanat hain. Raat ko uske andheron samet, din ko uske ujalon samet usne banaya hai. Kaise yakke baad deegare aate jaate hain? Suraj ko roshni aur chamakte chand ko aur uski nooraniyat ko dekh lo, unki bhi manzilein aur aasman muqarrar hain. Unke tulu-o-ghuroob se din raat ka farq ho jata hai. Mahine aur barson ki ginti maloom ho jati hai jis se ibadaat, mamlaat aur huqooq ki baqaida adaigi hoti hai. Chunki aasman-o-zameen mein zyada khoobsurat aur munawwar suraj aur chand tha, is liye unhein khusoosiyat se apna makhlooq hona bataya aur farmaya ke agar Allah ke bande ho to suraj chand ke samne matha na tekna, is liye ke woh makhlooq hain aur makhlooq sajda karne ke qabil nahin hoti. Sajda kiye jaane ke laiq woh hai jo sab ka Khaliq hai. Pas tum Allah ki ibadat kiye chale jao. Lekin agar tum ne Allah ke siwa uski kisi makhlooq ki bhi ibadat kar li to tum uski nazron se gir jaoge aur phir to woh tumhein kabhi na bakhshega. Jo log sirf uski ibadat nahin karte balki kisi aur ki bhi ibadat kar lete hain, woh yeh na samjhein ke Allah ke aabid wahi hain. Woh agar uski ibadat chhod denge to aur koi uska aabid nahin rahega. Nahin, nahin! Allah unki ibadaton se mahaz be-parwah hai. Uske farishte din raat uski pakeezgi ke bayan aur uski khalis ibadaton mein be-thake aur bin uktaye har waqt mashghool hain. Jaise aur aayat mein hai: Agar yeh kufr karein to hum ne ek qoum aisi bhi muqarrar kar rakhi hai jo kufr na karegi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Raat, din ko, suraj, chand ko aur hawa ko bura na kaho, yeh cheezein baaz logon ke liye rahmat hain aur baaz ke liye zahmat. Uski is qudrat ki nishani ke woh murdon ko zinda kar sakta hai, agar dekhna chahte ho to murda zameen ka barish se jee uthna dekh lo ke woh khushk, chatyal aur be-ghaas patton ke baghair hoti hai. Meenh baraste hi khetiyan, phal, sabza, ghaas aur phool waghera ug aate hain aur woh ek ajeeb andaaz se apne sabze ke sath lehlahane lagti hai. Ise zinda karne wala hi tumhein bhi zinda karega. Yaqeen mano ke woh jo chahe uski qudrat mein hai.

Azab-o-sawab na hota toh amal na hota. Ilhad ke ma'ani Ibn Abbas (R.A) se kalam ko us ki jagah se hata kar dusri jagah rakhne ke marvi hain aur Qatadah (R.H) waghera se Ilhad ke ma'ani kufr-o-inad hain. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke mulhid log hum se makhfi nahin. Hamare asma-o-sifat ko idhar udhar kar dene wale hamari nigahon mein hain. Unhein hum badtareen sazayein denge. Samajh lo ke kya jahannam wasil hone wala aur tamam khatron se bach rehne wala barabar hain? Hargiz nahin. Badkar kafiro! Jo chaho amal karte chale jao. Mujh se tumhara koi amal poshida nahin. Bareek se bareek cheez bhi meri nigahon se ojhal nahin. Jo apne aqwal-o-af'aal mein Hakeem hai. Us ke tamam tar ahkaam behtareen anjam wale hain, tujh se jo kuch tere zamane ke kuffar kehte hain yahi tujh se agle nabiyon ko un ki kafir ummaton ne kaha tha. Pas jaise un paighambaron ne sabr kiya tum bhi sabr karo. Jo bhi tere Rabb ki taraf ruju kare woh us ke liye badi bakhshishon wala hai aur jo apne kufr-o-zid par ada rahe mukhalifat-e-haq aur takzeeb-e-Rasool (ﷺ) se baaz na aaye us par woh sakht dard-naak sazayein karne wala hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain agar Allah Ta'ala ki bakhshish aur ma'afi na hoti toh duniya mein ek mutanaffis jee nahin sakta tha aur agar us ki pakad-dakad azab-o-saza na hoti toh har shakhs mutma'in ho kar tek laga kar be-khauf ho jata.

Quran-e-Kareem ki fasahat-o-balaghat, is ke hukm-o-ahkam, is ke lafzi-o-manvi fawaid ka bayan kar ke is par iman na lane walon ki sarkashi, zid aur adawat ka bayan farma raha hai. Jaise aur ayat mein hai. Matlab yeh hai ke na manne ke beesiyon heele hain, na yun chain na wun chain. Agar Quran kisi ajami zaban mein utarta to bahana karte ke hum to ise saaf saaf samajh nahin sakte. Mukhatib jab Arabi zaban ke hain to un par jo kitab utarti hai woh ghair-Arabi zaban mein kyun utar rahi hai? Aur agar kuch Arabi mein hoti aur kuch dusri zaban mein to bhi un ka yahi aitraz hota ke is ki kya wajah? Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) ki qirat 'Ajami' hai. Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) bhi yahi matlab bayan karte hain. Is se un ki sarkashi maloom hoti hai. Phir farman hai ke yeh Quran iman walon ke dil ki hidayat aur un ke seenon ki shifa hai. Un ke tamam shak is se zail ho jate hain aur jinhein is par iman nahin woh to ise samajh hi nahin sakte jaise koi behra ho. Na is ke bayan ki taraf unhein hidayat ho jaise koi andha ho. Aur ayat mein hai (Wa nunazzilu minal-Qurani ma huwa shifa'un wa rahmatul-lil-mu'mineen, wa la yaziduz-zalimina illa khasara - 17. Al-Isra: 82). Hamara nazil karda yeh Quran imandaron ke liye shifa aur rahmat hai. Haan zalimon ko to un ka nuqsan hi barhata hai. Un ki misal aisi hi hai jaise koi door se kisi se kuch keh raha ho ke na us ke kanon tak sahi alfaz pahunchte hain na woh theek tarah matlab samajhta hai. Jaise aur ayat mein hai (Wa masalul-lazina kafaru kamasalil-lazi yan'iqu bima la yasma'u illa du'an wa nida'an, bukmun 'umyun fahum la ya'qilun - 2. Al-Baqarah: 171). Ya'ni, kafiron ki misal us ki tarah hai jo pukarta hai magar awaz aur pukar ke siwa kuch aur us ke kan mein nahin parta. Behre, gunge, andhe hain phir kaise samajh lenge? Hazrat Zahhak (R.H) ne yeh matlab bayan farmaya hai ke Qayamat ke din unhein un ke badtareen namon se pukara jayega. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ek musalman ke paas baithe hue the jis ka akhri waqt tha, us ne yakayak 'Labbaik' pukara. Aap ne farmaya kya tujhe koi dekh raha hai ya koi pukara raha hai? Us ne kaha haan samundar ke is kinare se koi bula raha hai, to aap ne yahi jumla parha (Ula'ika yunadauna mim-makanim-ba'eed - 41. Fussilat: 44). (Ibn Abi Hatim). Phir farmata hai hum ne Musa (A.S) ko kitab di lekin is mein bhi ikhtilaf kiya gaya. Unhein bhi jhutlaya aur sataya gaya. Pas jaise unhon ne sabr kiya aap ko bhi sabr karna chahiye, chunke pehle hi se tere Rab ne is baat ka faisla kar liya hai ke ek waqt-e-muqarrar ya'ni Qayamat tak azab ruke rahenge. Is liye yeh mohlat-e-muqarrara hai, warna un ke kartoot to aise na the ke yeh chor diye jayen aur khate peete rahein. Abhi hi halak kar diye jate. Yeh apni takzeeb mein bhi kisi yaqeen par nahin balki shak mein hi pare hue hain. Laraz rahe hain, idhar udhar danwan-dol ho rahe hain.

Wallahu A'lam.

Nakarda gunah saza nahin pata. Is ayat ka matlab bahut saaf hai, bhalai karne wale ke aamal ka nafa usi ko hota hai aur burai karne wale ki burai ka wabaal bhi usi ki taraf laut-ta hai. Parwardigar ki zaat zulm se paak hai. Ek ke gunah par dusre ko woh nahin pakadta. Nakarda gunah ko woh saza nahin deta. Pehle apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhejta hai, apni Kitab utarta hai, apni hujjat tamam karta hai, apni baatein pahuncha deta hai, ab bhi jo na maane woh mustahiq-e-azab-o-saza qarar de diya jata hai.

Ilm-e-Ilahi ki wus'atein Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai ke Qayamat kab aayegi? Is ka ilm us ke siwa aur kisi ko nahin. Tamam insanon ke sardar Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ) se jab farishton ke sardaron mein se ek sardar yani Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ne Qayamat ke aane ka waqt poocha to aap ne farmaya ke jis se poocha jata hai woh bhi poochne wale se zyada janne wala nahin. Quran-e-Kareem ki ek aayat mein hai (اِلٰى رَبِّكَ مُنْتَهٰهَا 44؀ۭ) (79. An-Nazi'at: 44) yani Qayamat kab hogi? Is ke ilm ka madar tere Rab ki taraf hi hai. Isi tarah Allah Ta'ala Jalla Shanuhu ne aur jagah farmaya aayat (لَا يُجَلِّيْهَا لِوَقْتِهَآ اِلَّا هُوَ ۂ ثَقُلَتْ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ ۭ لَا تَاْتِيْكُمْ اِلَّا بَغْتَةً ۭ يَسْــــَٔـلُوْنَكَ كَاَنَّكَ حَفِيٌّ عَنْهَا قُلْ اِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ) (7. Al-A'raf: 187) matlab yahi hai ke Qayamat ke waqt ko Allah ke siwa aur koi nahin janta. Phir farmata hai ke har cheez ko us Allah ka ilm ghere hue hai yahan tak ke jo phal shagoofa se khul kar nikle, jis aurat ko hamal rahe, jo bacha use ho, yeh sab us ke ilm mein hai. Zameen-o-Aasman ka koi zarra us ke wasee ilm se bahar nahin. Jaise farmaya aayat (لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْـقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَلَا فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلَآ اَصْغَرُ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَآ اَكْبَرُ اِلَّا فِيْ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِيْنٍ) (34. Saba: 3). Ek aur aayat mein hai (وَمَا تَسْقُطُ مِنْ وَّرَقَةٍ اِلَّا يَعْلَمُهَا وَلَا حَبَّةٍ فِيْ ظُلُمٰتِ الْاَرْضِ وَلَا رَطْبٍ وَّلَا يَابِسٍ اِلَّا فِيْ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِيْنٍ) (6. Al-An'am: 59) yani jo patta jhadta hai use bhi woh janta hai. Har madda ko jo hamal rehta hai aur raham jo kuch ghatate badhate rehte hain Allah khoob janta hai, us ke paas har cheez ka andaza hai. Jis qadar umrein ghat-ti badhti hain woh bhi kitab mein likhi hui hain, aisa koi kaam nahin jo Allah par mushkil ho. Qayamat wale din mushrikon se tamam makhlooq ke samne Allah Ta'ala sawal karega ke jinhein tum mere sath parastish mein shareek karte the woh aaj kahan hain? Woh jawab denge ke Tu hamare bare mein ilm rakhta hai. Aaj to hum mein se koi bhi is ka iqrar na karega ke Tera koi shareek bhi hai, Qayamat wale din un ke maboodan-e-batil sab gum ho jayenge, koi nazar na aayega jo unhein nafa pahuncha sake. Aur yeh khud jaan lenge ke aaj Allah ke azab se chhutkare ki koi soorat nahin, yahan zann yaqeen ke ma'ani mein hai. Quran-e-Kareem ki aur aayat mein is mazmoon ko is tarah bayan kiya gaya hai aayat (وَرَاَ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ النَّارَ فَظَنُّوْٓا اَنَّهُمْ مُّوَاقِعُوْهَا وَلَمْ يَجِدُوْا عَنْهَا مَصْرِفًا) (18. Al-Kahf: 53) yani gunahgar log Jahannam dekh lenge aur unhein yaqeen ho jayega ke woh is mein girne wale hain aur is se bachne ki koi raah na payenge.

Aaj to hum mein se koi bhi is ka iqrar na karega ke Tera koi shareek bhi hai, Qayamat wale din un ke maboodan-e-batil sab gum ho jayenge, koi nazar na aayega jo unhein nafa pahuncha sake. Aur yeh khud jaan lenge ke aaj Allah ke azab se chhutkare ki koi soorat nahin, yahan zann yaqeen ke ma'ani mein hai. Quran-e-Kareem ki aur aayat mein is mazmoon ko is tarah bayan kiya gaya hai aayat (وَرَاَ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ النَّارَ فَظَنُّوْٓا اَنَّهُمْ مُّوَاقِعُوْهَا وَلَمْ يَجِدُوْا عَنْهَا مَصْرِفًا) (18. Al-Kahf: 53) yani gunahgar log Jahannam dekh lenge aur unhein yaqeen ho jayega ke woh is mein girne wale hain aur is se bachne ki koi raah na payenge.

Insaan ki sarkashi ka haal Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke maal, sehat wagairah bhalaiyon ki duaon se toh insaan thakta hi nahin aur agar is par koi bala aa pade ya faqr-o-faqa ka mauqa aa jaye toh is qadar harasaan aur mayoos ho jata hai ke goya ab kisi bhalai ka munh nahin dekhe ga, aur agar kisi burai ya sakhti ke baad use koi bhalai aur rahat mil jaye toh kehne baith jata hai ke Allah par yeh toh mera haq tha, main isi ke laiq tha, ab is nemat par phoolta hai, Allah ko bhool jata hai aur saaf munkir ban jata hai. Qayamat ke aane ka saaf inkaar kar jata hai. Maal-o-daulat, rahat-o-aaram us ke kufr ka sabab ban jata hai. Jaise ek aur aayat mein hai (Kalla innal insaana layatgha) (96. Al-Alaq: 6) yani insaan ne jahan aasayish-o-aaram paya wahin us ne sar uthaya aur sarkashi ki. Phir farmata hai ke itna hi nahin balkay is bad-aamali par bhali ummeedein bhi karta hai aur kehta hai ke bilfarz agar Qayamat aayi bhi aur main wahan ikatha bhi kiya gaya toh jis tarah yahan sukh chain mein hoon wahan bhi hoon ga. Garz inkaar-e-Qayamat bhi karta hai, marne ke baad zinda hone ko maanta bhi nahin aur phir ummeedein lambi bandhta hai aur kehta hai ke jaise main yahan hoon waise hi wahan bhi rahoon ga. Phir un logon ko darata hai ke jin ke yeh aamaal-o-aqaaid hon unhein hum sakht saza dein ge. Phir farmata hai ke jab insaan Allah ki nematein pa leta hai toh ita'at se munh mod leta hai aur maanne se ji churata hai jaise farmaya aayat (Fatawalla biruknihi wa qaala saahirun au majnoon) (51. Az-Zariyat: 39) aur jab use kuch nuqsan pahunchta hai toh badi lambi chauri duaein karne baith jata hai. 'Areed' kalaam use kehte hain jis ke alfaaz bahut zyada hon aur ma'ani bahut kam hon. Aur jo kalaam is ke khilaf ho yani alfaaz thode hon aur ma'ani zyada hon toh use 'Wajeez' kalaam kehte hain. Woh bahut kam aur bahut kaafi hota hai. Isi mazmoon ko aur jagah is tarah bayan kiya gaya hai aayat (Wa iza massal insaanad durru da'aana lijanbihi au qaa'idan au qaa'iman falamma kashafna anhu durrahu marra ka'allam yad'una ila durrin massahu kazalika zuyyina lilmusrifeena ma kaanu ya'maloon) (10. Yunus: 12), jab insaan ko museebat pahunchti hai toh apne pehlu par lait kar aur baith kar aur khade ho kar garz har waqt hum se munajaat karta rehta hai aur jab woh takleef hum door kar dete hain toh is be-parwahi se chala jata hai ke goya is museebat ke waqt us ne hamein pukara hi na tha.

Quran-e-Kareem ki haqaniyat ke ba'az dalail. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farmata hai ke Quran ke jhutlane wale mushrikon se keh do ke maan lo yeh Quran sach-much Allah hi ki taraf se hai aur tum ise jhutla rahe ho toh Allah ke yahan tumhara kya haal hoga? Is se barh kar gumrah aur kaun hoga jo apne kufr aur apni mukhalifat ki wajah se rah-e-haq se aur maslak-e-hidayat se bahut door nikal gaya ho. Phir Allah Ta'ala Azza-wa-Jal farmata hai ke Quran-e-Kareem ki haqaniyat ki nishaniyan aur khaslatein unhein un ke gird-o-nawah mein duniya ke charon taraf dikha denge. Musalmanon ko futuhat hasil hongi, woh saltanaton ke sultan banenge. Tamam deenon par is deen ko ghalba hoga, Fatah-e-Badr aur Fatah-e-Makkah ki nishaniyan khud un mein maujood hongi. Kafir log tadaad aur shaan-o-shaukat mein bahut zyada honge phir bhi mutthi bhar ahl-e-haq unhein zer-o-zabar kar denge aur mumkin hai yeh murad ho ke hikmat-e-Ilahi ki hazarha nishaniyan khud insaan ke apne wujood mein maujood hain. Is ki sanat-o-banawat, is ki tarkeeb-o-jibillat, is ke judagana akhlaq aur mukhtalif suratein aur rang-roop waghera is ke khaliq-o-sani ki behtareen yaadgarein har waqt is ke samne hain, balkay is ki apni zaat mein maujood hain. Phir is ka her-pher, kabhi koi halat kabhi koi halat. Bachpan, jawani, burhapa, bimari, tandurusti, tangi, farakhi, ranj-o-rahat waghera ausaf jo is par tari hote hain. Sheikh Abu Jafar Qurashi ne apne ashaar mein bhi isi mazmoon ko ada kiya hai. Al-gharaz yeh bairooni aur androoni aayat-e-qudrat is qadar hain ke insaan Allah ki baton ki haqaniyat ke manne par majboor ho jata hai. Allah Ta'ala ki gawahi bas kaafi hai, woh apne bandon ke aqwal-o-af'aal se bakhoobi waqif hai. Jab woh farma raha hai ke Paighambar Sahab (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sache hain toh phir tumhein kya shak? Jaise irshad hai aayat: (Lakinillahu yash-hadu bima anzala ilaika anzalahu bi-ilmihi wal-malaikatu yash-hadoona wa kafa billahi shaheeda) (Surah An-Nisa: 166) yani lekin Allah Ta'ala is kitab ke zariye jis ko tumhare paas bheji hai aur apne ilm ke sath nazil farmayi hai khud gawahi de raha hai aur farishtay is ki tasdeeq kar rahe hain aur Allah Ta'ala ki gawahi kaafi hai. Phir farmata hai ke darasal in logon ko Qayamat ke qaim hone ka yaqeen hi nahin isi liye be-fikr hain, nekiyon se ghafil hain, buraiyon se bachte nahin. Halankay is ka aana yaqeeni hai. Ibn-e-Abi-Dunya mein hai ke Khalifat-ul-Muslimeen Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.A) mimbar par charhe aur Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana ke baad farmaya: Logo! Main ne tumhein kisi nayi baat ke liye jama nahin kiya balkay sirf is liye jama kiya hai ke tumhein yeh suna doon ke roz-e-jaza ke bare mein main ne khoob gaur kiya, main is natijay par pahuncha hoon ke ise sacha janne wala ahmaq hai aur ise jhoota janne wala halak hone wala hai. Phir aap mimbar se utar aaye.

Aap ke is farman ka ke ise sacha janne wala ahmaq hai, yeh matlab hai ke sach janta hai phir tayyari nahin karta aur is ki dil hila dene wali dehshat-naak halaton se ghafil hai. Is se dar kar woh aamal nahin karta jo ise us roz ke dar se aman de sakein, phir apne aap ko is ka sacha janne wala bhi kehta hai, lahw-o-la'ab, ghaflat-o-shahwat, gunah aur hamaqat mein mubtala hai aur qayam-e-qayamat ke qareeb ho raha hai, Wallahu A'alam. Phir Rabb-ul-Aalameen apni qudrat-e-kamilah ko bayan farma raha hai ke har cheez par is ka ihata hai, qayam-e-qayamat is par bilkul sahl hai, sari makhlooq is ke qabze mein hai, jo chahe kare, koi is ka haath tham nahin sakta, jo is ne chaha hua, jo chahe ga ho kar rahe ga, is ke siwa haqeeqi hakim koi nahin hai, na is ke siwa kisi aur ki zaat kisi qisam ki ibadat ke qabil hai.
